name: Accelerock
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
description: The Pokémon dashes at great speed using the rocks on their body to strike the foe upon impact.

name: Air Cutter
effect: Target All Foes in Range. High Critical. Wind Move. Cutter Move.
description: A sharp wide wave of wind is sent out , everyone can feel it slicing throught their midsection.

name: Air Slash
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: A compressed wind-slash, the change of pressure knocks out the target momentarily

name: Acid
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
description: The Pokémon spits an acidic gunk into the foe that immediately gives burning sensation. Keep away from the eyes and wash with abundant water.

name: Anchor Shot
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon hurls an anchor at the foe and entangles it with seaweed, the anchor drags the foe down so it cannot escape.

name: Aerial Ace
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Never Miss.
description: The Pokémon rises up in the air towards a light source, momentarily blinding the foe. then plummets quickly to attack the opponent

name: Aromatherapy
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Cure Status Ailments (All Burn degrees, Freeze, Paralysis, All Poison & Sleep) on the Targets.
description: The Pokémon releases a series of essential oils and herbal scents to refresh themselves and their companions.

name: Ancient Power
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The Pokémon calls forward an energy from the ancient past. This may infuse the user with a primal strength.

name: Aura Wheel
effect: Single Target. Increase the user's Dexterity by 1. If the user of this Move is in "Hangry Form" this Move is considered Dark-Type.
description: The Pokémon happily runs into a wheel made of electricity that strikes the foe. If the user is feeling hungry the wheel’s energy is replaced by a dark aura.

name: Aqua Tail
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: The user sways their tail to create a pocket whirlpool in which the foe gets sucked in by the spinning motion.

name: Barrage
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Move.
description: The Pokémon throws whatever objects they find, one after the other to overwhelm the foe.

name: Behemoth Bash
effect: Single Target. Unique. *If the Foe is under the effects of Dynamax/Gigantamax, This Move becomes Lethal and add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
description: The Pokémon becomes a giant energy shield that pushes back everything in its wake. If the foe is under the effects of the Dynamax phenomenon all its energy will be swept away

name: Body Press
effect: Single Target.
description: The Pokémon makes a judo maneuver, using its body mass instead of its strength against the target.

name: Aurora Beam
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce target's Strength by 1.
description: The Pokémon shoots a beautiful shimmering beam that cools down a hot temper.

name: Bone Club
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon uses a bone as a club to to smack their foe, a loud “Bonk!” sound can be heard.

name: Bolt Beak
effect: Single Target. *If this is the first Action of the Round for the User, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move
description: The Pokémon charges with its beak and pecks its foe. If the foe is not fast enough it will be zapped with a jolt of electricity.

name: Brave Bird
effect: Single Target. Recoil.
description: Back in the day humans relied on birds to send their messages and even go to war. Many earned medals for bravery.

name: Bullet Punch
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Fist Move.
description: You cannot outrun a bullet.

name: Charm
effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 2.
description: The Pokémon engages their foe in a charming interaction to reduce their aggressive intent.

name: Crabhammer
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. High Critical
description: The Pokémon uses their powerful claws to beat down any foe. There’s a reason seafood is not too popular in this world.

name: Cut
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. Out of battle it will help to easily cut down trees and obstacles.
description: A swift and precise cut that can even slice a tree in half.

name: Dragon Hammer
effect: Single Target.
description: The Pokémon swings its body as a hammer and leaves the foe nailed to the cracked ground.

name: Dragon Ascent
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The user rises above the clouds and then comes crashing down against its foe in an instant. The strike is brutal for the both of them.

name: Dragon Rush
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon rushes to charge against their foe. Unlucky victims end up crushed into the ground.

name: Echoed Voice
effect: Single Target. Sound Move. This Move can be used many times in the same Round. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage pool of this move for each time you use it. Up to 8 Dice might be added this way. Reset this effect if the user performs another move, evasion or clash.
description: The Pokémon yells at the void. Their echo answers. The Pokémon yells louder and louder everytime the echo talks back.

name: Endeavor
effect: Single Target. Roll Dice of Normal-Type Damage equal to the difference between the User's current HP and the Target's max HP. Ignore defenses. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. This Damage cannot make the Target's HP go lower than the User's current HP.
description: Through sheer willpower the Pokémon manages to level the conditions of the battle despite their own injuries.

name: Feather Dance
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 2.
description: A dance as soft as a feather. It soothes the hearts of the spectators and reduces all aggression.

name: Facade
effect: Single Target. *If the User has a Status Ailment (Paralysis, Poison, Burn, etc.) Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage pool.
description: The Pokémon puts on a brave face through the most difficult of situations.

name: False Surrender
effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
description: The Pokémon bows down in defeat, begging for forgiveness; then backstabs the guillible foe.

name: Bide
effect: Single Target. The User will not Evade or Clash the next 2 Physical or Special Moves targeting it. Once all damage has been dealt against the User, roll a number of Normal-Type Damage dice equal to twice the total amount of Damage the Target received. Ignore Defenses.
description: The user puts up with being hit, waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate.

name: Blast Burn
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Must Recharge.
description: The Pokémon creates an enormous blast of infernal flames, surviving would be a miracle!

name: Bounce
effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
description: The Pokémon jumps at least 30 feet in the air before landing with a mighty stomp on top of the foe. While in the air it is safe from most treaths but its still vulnerable to bad weather.

name: Chip Away
effect: Single Target. Ignore Cover & Substitute decoys. Ignore Defenses. Remove effects that increase Evasion Actions from the Target (ie Moves like: Double Team, Minimize. Abilities like: Sand Veil)
description: Bit by bit the Pokémon finds an opening though all layers of defense their target has until there is nothing left to protect it from a direct strike.

name: Circle Throw
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy -1. Late Reaction 1. Switcher Move for the foe.
description: Using their best sumo moves, the Pokémon throws the foe 60ft. out of the battlefield.

name: Comet Punch
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Successive Actions.
description: A series of rapid punches. So fast they leace a luminous trail behind like a comet’s.

name: Cross Poison
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. High Critical. Roll 1 Chance Die to Poison the Target.
description: The Pokémon releases a powerful acidic gas that melts all inorganic matter in seconds.

name: Crush Claw
effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
description: With a crushing grip against the foe, the user manages to break their armor.

name: Doom Desire
effect: Single Target. Unique. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Rund. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute decoys. If the target retires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies. Extra effects may be added at Storyteller's Discretion.
description: Be careful what you wish for, this Pokémon will read your most intimate wishes and make them come true in very twisted ways.

name: Draco Meteor
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
description: The Pokémon summons a meteor to fall from the sky directly into their foes, dealing a brutal amount of damage. An impressive display if power that demands a lot of energy.

name: Dynamax Cannon
effect: Single Target. *If the Target is under the effects of Dynamax, this Move becomes Lethal and you add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
description: The Pokémon shoots a heavy projectile, if the foe is under the effects of the Dynamax phenomenon all the energy will be concentrated and explode on the Target.

name: Embargo
effect: Single Target. The Target loses its Held Item. Target's Trainer & Partners can't use Items on the Target. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The user demands the held item of a Pokémon and the items in the bag of their trainer. Scared, both Pokémon and Trainer comply

name: Fake Out
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Flinch the Target. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. from the Second Round on, it will fail automatically.
description: The Pokémon pretends to be getting ready for the battle when they are actually prepairing a surprise attack on the foe.

name: Assurance
effect: Single Target. *Add 2 extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target has already received Damage from the User this Round.
description: The user indentifies the weakest foe and charges against them.

name: Branch Poke
effect: Single Target.
description: The Pokémon rudely starts poking its foe with a stick.

name: Bubble Beam
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
description: A powerful stream of foamy bubbles shot straight into the foe

name: Clanging Scales
effect: Target all Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce User's Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon rattles the scales of its armor creating a frightening noise in the area. Some of its scales fall off as a result, leaving some areas exposed.

name: Clear Smog
effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Reset all Increased or Reduced Attributes on the Foe.
description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

name: Covet
effect: Single Target. The User steals the Target's Held Item. If the User already has a Held Item, this effect fails.
description: The Pokémon is attracted to shiny and colorful items. They don’t understand when something is not theirs for the taking so they just take it when no one is looking.

name: Darkest Lariat
effect: Single Target. Ignore Defenses.
description: The user swings both of its arms against the target, there’s no armor thick enough to stop this cruel strike.

name: Defog
effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Terrains (Misty Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) from the Battlefield.
description: A strong wind sweeps out the battle field, removing anything from bad weather to scattered objects and even invisible barriers.

name: Dark Void
effect: Target all foes in Range. Low Accuracy 3. Put those affected to Sleep.
description: A portal opens and transports all foes to a world of darkness, inside they can’t see or feel anything, it’s like they are trapped in an eternal slumber.

name: Double Hit
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
description: The Pokémon uses the true and tested “one-two”.

name: Dizzy Punch
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
description: The Pokémon locates their enemy’s balance point and lands a swift punch that leaves the foe seeing a swirl of stars around its head.

name: Dragon Claw
effect: Single Target.
description: The Pokémon uses its strong claws to deliver a fierce tearing blow.

name: Earth Power
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
description: The user sends out a subterranean wave that bursts the ground below the target. It’s as if the earth bends to the user’s will.

name: Electric Terrain
effect: Target Battlefield. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves. Pokemon without immunity to Ground will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The user electrifies the battlefield, making it impossible to relax around the sparks and live current.

name: Dream Eater
effect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target has the Sleep Condition, otherwise it will fail. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
description: The Pokémon enters the dream world for a snack. The dreams of children and baby Pokémon are the tastiest.

name: Fairy Wind
effect: Single Target. Wind Move.
description: The Pokémon let’s out sweet a breeze of glittery fairy dust. It gives a mild rash to those without happy thoughts.

name: Bone Rush
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
description: The foe is assaulted by a series of flurry strikes with a bone club.

name: Bug Buzz
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Sp. Defense of those affected.
description: The Pokémon uses their wings or a part of their bodies to emit distracting buzzes all around.

name: Brutal Swing
effect: Target All foes in Range. Lethal.
description: The Pokémon starts attacking at full force with its claws, anyone unfortunate enough to be in its path will end up severely wounded.

name: Buzzy Buzz
effect: Single Target. Paralyze the foe. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: The Pokémon releases a jolt of static electricity from its fur, that makes a cute zapping sound. It’s all fun and games until somebody gets paralyzed.

name: Clamp
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Block both User and Target. Ongoing Damage. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: Lured by a beautiful pearl, the target is clamped by the user’s sturdy shell. The user will not release the target until they no longer feel movement.

name: Confide
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Special by 1.
description: The Pokémon tells a secret to the target. They giggle together but the foe loses its concentration on the battle.

name: Constrict
effect: Single Target. This Move deals Typeless damage. Roll 1 chance die to reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
description: The Pokémon tightens their hold on the foe to keep them locked in a squeeze.

name: Dazzling Gleam
effect: Target All foes in Range.
description: The Pokémon shines bright like a diamond. The powerful flash hurts the eyes of everyone watching.

name: Dragon Darts
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Double Action.
description: The Pokémon’s head is a nest for its less evolved forms, the younglings will sometimes be used as projectiles.

name: Electroweb
effect: Target All foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
description: An electrified web is shot towards the target, shoking and tangling them at the same time.

name: Extrasensory
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon alters their target’s senses, making it feel things that aren’t really there.

name: Flamethrower
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
description: The most emblematic fire attack, a seeminly endless stream of fire that reduces everything and everyone to ashes.

name: Focus Punch
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Charge Move. The User Flinches if it is hit while Charging this Move.
description: The user must focus on delivering the greatest punch in history, if they succeed they’ll be known as the One-Punch Pokémon.

name: Gastro Acid
effect: Single Target. Negate any effect the Target's Ability would have. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The user spews their gastric juices on the foe. It’s so disgusting the foe can only concentrate on getting cleaned ASAP

name: Frost Breath
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. This Move is always considered to be a Critical hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.
description: The user locates the most exposed parts of its foe and sends a gelid breath against it. The sudden chill goes right through the foe’s spine.

name: Aqua Jet
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
description: The Pokémon propels themselves with a jet of pressured water.

name: Bestow
effect: Single Target. Can't be used if Target is not holding an Item. The User gives its Held Item to the Target.
description: The Pokémon offers their own item to the foe to show their good manners. The foe keeps it as they don’t want to be seem as impolite.

name: Bolt Strike
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Unique. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the foe.
description: Zekrom delivers a powerful tackle while discharging lightning through its body. The foe is rendered unable to move, either by the strike of the electricity.

name: Brick Break
effect: Single Target. *If there is a Force field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it and add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
description: The Pokémon uses a karate technique to chop through tall piles of bricks. No matter how many layers you pile up, they’ll break regardless.

name: Bug Bite
effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If the target Pokemon is holding a berry, the User eats it and gains its effects.
description: The Pokémon nibbles at their foe in hopes of finding something tasty to snack on.

name: Crunch
effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Lethal. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the foe's Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon viciously mauls, tears, and rips apart anything its fangs can come in contact with.

name: Court Change
effect: Target Battlefield. Swap any Force Fields, Entry Hazards and Effects on the Foe's side of the field (ie Tailwind, Grassy Terrain healing, Fire Pledge.) for those on the User's side.
description: The Pokémon signals the referee for half-time, the referee complies and both parties swap their sides of the field. Wait... we brought everything with us, right?

name: Diamond Storm
effect: All foes in range. Ranged. Roll 5 chance dice to increase the user's defense by 2.
description: The Pokémon summons a storm of diamonds over the field. These diamonds also serve as barriers the user can take cover into.

name: Dragon Pulse
effect: Single Target.
description: The Pokémon sends out a powerful wave of energy through their mouth.

name: Dragon Tail
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
description: The Pokémon sends their opponent flying up to 100ft in the air with a strong flick of their tail.

name: Drill Peck
effect: Single Target. Lethal.
description: A bird has no fangs, yet they can still can tear flesh.

name: Dual Chop
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
description: Two brutal blows are all this Pokémon needs to make the opponent yield to their might.

name: Egg Bomb
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Projectile Move.
description: The target can’t take a yolk. Let’s make them laugh with an egg-cellent pun to crack them up.

name: Explosion
effect: Area Move. Ranged. Lethal. The User Faints.
description: Through a massive explosion the Pokémon destroys all they can before fainting. Sometimes the only way to get out of a bad situation is in bits and pieces.

name: Feint Attack
effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
description: The user approaches inconspicuously, pretending to attack the foe directly, then actually hits the foe from behind.

name: Baby-Doll Eyes
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
description: The biggest and brightest eyes, spakling with unshed tears, how can you say “no” to that?!

name: Brine
effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if the Target is at half HP or less.
description: A splash of sea water that literally adds more and more salt to the foe’s wounds.

name: Chatter
effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
description: The Pokémon parrots the voice of a human and starts issuing silly commands to the foe. This quickly becomes confusing for the foe.

name: Copycat
effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
description: The user is incredibly observant and has a talent for impersonations, no one will tell the difference!

name: Cotton Guard
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 3.
description: The Pokémon grows a lush coat of cotton puffs. The cotton greatly reduces all kinds of impact.

name: Dark Pulse
effect: Target Random Foe. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: A haze of dark energy decends on the battlefield preying on those vulnerable to the obscure feelings and fears it provokes.

name: Dive
effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Scald/ Surf/ Whirlpool/ Freeze-Dry/ Sheer Cold. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to move underwater carrying someone without risk of drowning.
description: Just look at the world around you right here on the ocean floor, such wonderful things surround you. What more are you lookin’ for?

name: Dragon Rage
effect: Single Target. Set Damage. Deal 2 Dragon-Type Damage to the Target.
description: The Pokémon focuses their inner rage and makes it not-soinner anymore.

name: Drill Run
effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical.
description: The Pokémon holds their claws together and starts spinning as if they were a drill. They can puncture a hole into any surface from walls and floors to their foes.

name: Eerie Impulse
effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Special by 2.
description: The user radiates electricity around itself so the foe will think twice about attacking.

name: Entrainment
effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with the User's. Unique Abilities can't be passed or replaced. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
description: The Pokémon trains and teaches their best ability to their target. The target becomes a master of this ability in a record time.

name: Extreme Speed
effect: Single Target. Reaction 2. Out of battle, triple the Pokemon's movement speed.
description: Gotta go extremely fast.

name: Fire Punch
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
description: A fist powered by the fiery spirit of combat, the heat of the battle lights of for real as the punch hits the foe right where it hurts!

name: First Impression
effect: Single Target. Reaction 2. This Move will only work on the First Round the User is out in battle. From the second round on, it will fail automatically.
description: The Pokémon makes a dramatic entrance to the battlefield, taking the foe by surprise.

name: Flail
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing Point of HP the user has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
description: The user flails around trying to stay alive, as they get closer to fainting, more adrenaline will fuel their efforts of survival.

name: Aurora Veil
effect: Target User's Side of the Field. Force Field against Physical & Special Damage. This move will fail if not performed under Hail/Snowy Weather. Duration 4 Rounds, even if Hail or Snow Weather is over.
description: If the weather is cold enough, beautiful aurora lights will cover half of the battlefield, deflecting attacks.

name: Beat Up
effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move for every ally Pokemon that spends an action in addition to this Move, up to 3 allies may join.
description: The user calls other Pokémon to aid it in battle, together they give a beating to the foe.

name: Blaze Kick
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. High Critical. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
description: Setting their legs ablaze, the Pokémon throws a mighty kick that sears the sides of the foe.

name: Bonemerang
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Double Action.
description: The Pokémon throws their bone against the foe, the bone spins in the air and makes a comeback to strike a second time.

name: Boomburst
effect: Area Move. Sound Move.
description: The Pokémon creates a sudden explosive sound that deafens everyone around.

name: Bulldoze
effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
description: The user stomps and flattens the ground, pushing all the rubbish and leaving the surface ready for construction.

name: Bullet Seed
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Moves.
description: The Pokémon starts shooting seed as if they were a machine gun.

name: Charge Beam
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Increase User's Special by 1.
description: The Pokémon releases an electric beam, if any charge remains unused, it will make use of it to boost its power.

name: Confuse Ray
effect: Single Target. Confuse the Target.
description: The user flashes a sinister ray of bright light that others cannot help but go straight into it.

name: Disable
effect: Single Target. Disable the last Move performed by the Target. Only one Move may be Disabled at a time.
description: The Pokémon finds the right nerve to pull that will render a foe useless to perform their best Move.

name: Double-Edge
effect: Single Target. Recoil.
description: Without regard for their own safety, the Pokémon does a reckless attack against their foe.

name: Drain Punch
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
description: A solid punch that weakens the foes and revitalizes the user with each hit.

name: Drum Beating
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
description: The Pokémon has a perfectly good drum and you’d think it would use it. But it doesn’t, It uses it’s foe.

name: Earthquake
effect: Area Move. Ranged. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
description: The user calls the forces of nature. The earth shakes violently and everything crumbles to the ground.

name: Fairy Lock
effect: Target Battlefield. Block. Duration 1 Round.
description: The User moves as if locking a door, preventing anyone from leaving the room. It takes everyone a few seconds to realize they are not really trapped.

name: False Swipe
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. This Move's Damage can't make the Target go below 1 HP.
description: Through their most dramatic poses, the Pokémon pretends to slice up the foe (the blood is fake).

name: Aura Sphere
effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Projectile Move.
description: By channeling their own aura, the user launches an energy sphere that causes harm on an spiritual level more than a physical one.

name: Body Slam
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
description: The user charges against the foe using ther body to slam it down, leaving the target stunned.

name: Breaking Swipe
effect: All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
description: The Pokémon will make a long swipe at using its tail. All foes fall to the ground and come up pretty bruised.

name: Bubble
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
description: Dozens of bubbles are sent floating through the battlefield. The foes can’t resist the temptation to burst the pretty bubbles, only for the bubbles to explode for real when they do.

name: Burn Up
effect: Single Target. Lethal. After damage is dealt, the user loses its Fire-Type. If its only type was Fire, it is now Typeless. User's Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the User.
description: The User unleashes all of its might through a massive blast of raging fire. Although the damage is devastating the Pokémon is left unable to produce more fire for a while.

name: Confusion
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
description: A basic mental assault that makes the foe believe they are being attacked by an invisible enemy.

name: Cross Chop
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. High Critical.
description: The Pokémon delivers a chop with crossed arms, a quite impractical but extremely cool technique.

name: Double Kick
effect: Single Target. Double Action.
description: The good old one-two but with a twist.

name: Dig
effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Earth Power/ Earthquake/ Fissure/ Magnitude/ Stomping Tantrum. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to burrow and make underground tunnels.
description: The user digs a tunnel on the ground and attacks by coming out from below its target. This move has been used to escape caves and gain access to highly surveiled places.

name: Draining Kiss
effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
description: The Pokémon blows a flirtatious kiss; the foe catches it believing to have found love, but it turns out to be a trick to steal its life energy.

name: Electrify
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. All Damage of the Next Physical or Special Move the Target performs will become Electric-Type
description: The user hurls a sudden electric jolt onto its target. The target’s is now charged and will need to release the excess energy through an attack.

name: Ember
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
description: A basic fire attack, but not any less dangerous. Even a small flame can grow out of control.

name: Fake Tears
effect: Single Target. Reduce foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
description: The user stops mid-combat to start crying; feeling incredibly guilty, the foe lowers its guard.

name: Final Gambit
effect: Single Target. Ignore Defenses. The user Faints after dealing Damage.
description: The Pokémon puts its last Strength into an all-or-nothing attack. After that, the user faints.

name: Flame Wheel
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
description: The user surrounds themselves with fire, then curl into a ball and runs over the target in a fiery spin.

name: Cotton Spore
effect: Single Target. Powder Move. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
description: The foe is covered head to toe in cotton fluff, disrupting its movement.

name: Crafty Shield
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Negate the Added Effects from Moves made against the Targets.
description: The Pokémon creates a magic shield to protect everyone from any tricks a foe has up their sleeve. Under this shield, everyone can see dishonesty and bad intentions

name: Double Slap
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
description: The name is misleading as the user slaps withouth even counting how many slaps they have given already

name: Dragon Breath
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
description: A mystical flame breath that feels strengely cold to the touch. It doesn’t burn in a conventional way.

name: Dynamic Punch
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Fist Move. Confuse the Target.
description: A punch to a vital pressure point on the foe to disrupt their sense of balance

name: Electro Ball
effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the user for every Point on Dexterity it has that surpasses the Foe's. Up to 4 Dice might be added this way.
description: An orb of electricity is hurled against the target, the faster the user dashes, the more momentum the orb gets.

name: Fissure
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damge. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
description: The earth rips apart underneath the target and swallows them whole. You’ll need a rescue team to recover the unlucky victim from the deep.

name: Flying Press
effect: Single Target. This move deals damage as if it was also Flying-Type.
description: The user jumps up the ropes to hit the foe using their knees in pure Lucha Libre style!

name: Forest's Curse
effect: Single Target. Add the Grass Type to the Target's Type. (ie Pikachu will now be "Electric/Grass", Charizard will not be "Fire/Flying/Grass") If the Target already has a third Type attached, replace it.
description: The user lays the forest’scurse upon the target, causing roots and branches to grow on its body until they are a haunted tree. Perform an exorcism or get to a Pokémon Center ASAP

name: Giga Drain
effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
description: The Pokémon drains most of the foe’s vital energy and feeds on the nutrients it managed to extract.

name: Grass Knot
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Damage Dice for every 50kg of weight on the foe, up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
description: The user snares the foe’s feet with a grass tangle to make it fall into the ground. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

name: Haze
effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits of everyone on the battlefield.
description: The battlefield is filled with a cleansing cloud that takes away all impurities in the field. It can also work as concealment.

name: Hydro Pump
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2
description: Water works best under pressure.

name: Hypnosis
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Put the Target to sleep. Dark-Type Pokemon are affected by this Move.
description: By staring at an hypnotic pendulum, the target is suggestioned to feel tired and close its eyelids.

name: Fire Blast
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
description: The Pokémon shoots a giant fireball that explodes as soon as it touches their target. Blasting fire in all directions.

name: Fire Spin
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
description: The user creates a vortex of fire that remains spinning in the battlefield, trapping the foe within.

name: Flare Blitz
effect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 1 Chance die to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
description: A reckless blazing charge against their foe, ends up with an explosive collision

name: Foul Play
effect: Single Target. S.T.A.B. of the User and the Strength/Special of the foe are used for this Move's Damage Pool.
description: The user feints an attack that tricks the foe into hurting itself.

name: Frustration
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every missing point of Happiness on the user. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
description: A mistreated Pokémon grows vicious and uncaring, a Move fueled by anger.

name: Gear Grind
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Double Action.
description: The foe gets trapped into two gears, the only way out is to let the gears grind against its crushed body.

name: Grav Apple
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon rises on top of its foe and drops an apple on their head. The foe proceeds to eat the apple, distracting it from the fight.

name: Guard Split
effect: Single Target. Average the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's, rounded down.
description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other weaknesses, which end up evening the odds.

name: Ice Fang
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
description: The Pokémon bites their foe with sharp teeth and a geli breath to chill their bones directly

name: Incinerate
effect: Single Target. All Foes in Range. Destroy the held item of those affected.
description: A small blast of fire that instantly consumes small flammable objects.

name: Inferno
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Lethal. Inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
description: The user sets their target on fire with unforgiving flames. Abandon all hope.

name: Life Dew
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. User and Allies in Range heal 1 HP at the end of each Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The user creates a fresh-water dew that restores energy and heals wounds.

name: Lava Plume
effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
description: The floor is lava. The sky is lava. Everywhere is lava. Hundreds of lava bits start raining scattered around the field.

name: Low Kick
effect: Single Target. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice for every 50kg of the weight on the foe, up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
description: The Pokémon uses a kick to the sheen to throw the foe into the ground. The bigger they are, the harder they fall.

name: Smog
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 4 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
description: The Pokémon releases a stream of filthy gases. The foe may try to hold their breath, but for how long?

name: Fire Lash
effect: Single Target. Reduce Foe's Defense by 1.
description: With a whip of fire, the Pokémon ensnares its foe, who is left defenseless and at its mercy

name: Flash
effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
description: The Pokémon glows with a bright light to temporarily blind and dazzle their foe. It’s also perfect to light up dark places.

name: Freezy Frost
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Remove all Increased or Reduced Attributes and Traits the Target may have. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: The user touches its foe while saying “Freeze!”, surprisingly, the foe becomes frozen on a block of ice that melts as soon as the foe realizes it was just a game.

name: Grassy Terrain
effect: Target User's side of the field. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Grass-Type Moves. Everyone on the User's side of the field heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will Point t activate. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: A patch of grass grows in the area surrounding the user, through it nature grants her many blessings.

name: Hail
effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Hail Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The skies turn gray, and loud thunder rumbles, but what falls is not a gentle drizzle, but an endless stream of ice shards coming down at high speeds. Find shelter!

name: Heat Wave
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to inflict 1st Degree Burn on those affected.
description: A large wave of extra-hot air that can set fire to everything it touches.

name: Horn Attack
effect: Single Target.
description: The user has horns. Did you not expect they’ll use them?

name: Hyper Beam
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
description: A devastating beam, a path of destruction that can extend for miles is the unmistakable proof someone used this Move. Let the user rest before trying to use it again.

name: Ice Punch
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target.
description: The Pokémon wears their ice gloves to punch the foe. Yes. Gloves made of ice.

name: Ice Shard
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Ranged.
description: With extraordinary swiftness, the Pokémon shoots an ice bullet like the fastest gun in the North Pole.

name: Jump Kick
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 4 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
description: The user launches itself up two stories high to pummel down with a powerful kick. Do not try it at home.

name: Leaf Tornado
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 Success from all Accuracy Rolls of the foe.
description: A cluster of leaves and twigs swirls around the foe, getting in its eyes and making it difficult to aim properly

name: Leaf Blade
effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Cutter Move.
description: Danger lies not on the material’s toughness but on its edge’s sharpness.

name: Mega Drain
effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
description: The user absorbs a big amount of vital energy and nutrients from the target to feed from.

name: Wing Attack
effect: Single Target.
description: A classic flying technique, the user flies towards the foe and strikes using their wings.

name: Flame Charge
effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
description: The Pokémon dashes so fast they leave a trail of fire behind.

name: Flower Shield
effect: Target battlefield. Increase by 1 the Defense of all Grass-Type Pokemon.
description: The whole field grows flowers and those flowers keep growing on top of all Grass-Type Pokémon in the field, providing a mild cover and protection from harm.

name: Flatter
effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Special by 1. Confuse the Target.
description: The user starts flattering and admiring its opponent. It sure makes them feel good about themselves but...why?!

name: Giga Impact
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal.
description: The Pokémon strikes with such a brutal force they leave a crater just from the impact. Let them catch their breath afterwards.

name: Grass Whistle
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Put the Target to Sleep.
description: A soothing and relaxing melody created with the sounds of nature. It is a very subtle tone, so it may be hard to listen.

name: Head Charge
effect: Single Target. Recoil.
description: The Pokémon is headstrong, in head-to-head competitions they will always charge head on.

name: Heart Stamp
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon controls the emotions of their victims just as they start to feel loved and safe, the Pokémon strikes. The poor victim is left broken hearted for a few seconds.

name: Hurricane
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
description: The Pokémon calls upon fierce gale winds. It’ll be difficult to summon the tempest on a clear day, but a little rain will enhance it into a typhoon. Other pokémon in the air are in most danger.

name: Horn Drill
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
description: The Pokémon stabs the target with a spinning horn, drilling through them until they are critical condition. Hurry to the nearest Pokémon Center.

name: Ion Deluge
effect: Target Battlefield. Damage from Normal-Type Moves will be considered to be Electric-Type. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The user electrifies all the particles in the environment with shocking results!

name: Jaw Lock
effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Blocks both User and Target. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The user will capture its foe in a crushing jaw grip. It won’t let go no matter how much you try to separate them. The only way it will release its victim is if one of them faints.

name: Liquidation
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon strikes while bursting a full-force blast of pressurized water. The water may cut or dent through the target’s armor.

name: Magma Storm
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Blocks. Roll 3 Fire-Type Damage Dice ignoring defenses at the end of each Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The Pokémon shoots a fiery eruption to its foe. Unable to escape and surrounded by the unbearable heat the foe’s survival is at risk.

name: Floaty Fall
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. If the user of this Movve is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: With the help of 99 air balloons, the user jumps up high and falls on top of its foe. The use of 99 balloons in-battle is questionable, but the referee will allow them.

name: Fly
effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Out of battle allows the Pokemon to fly long distances.
description: The Pokémon uses an action to fly up high, to asses the best angle to take a dive against the foe. Pokémon who know this Move can fly for long periods of time without rest.

name: Fury Swipes
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
description: With their sharp claws, the Pokémon will swiftly scatch their foe, leaving its face full of small cuts.

name: Fusion Flare
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. *If the Move "Fusion Bolt" has already been used by anyone this Round, add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
description: The Pokémon sets ablaze a swirling pillar upon the target, said pillar will grow taller and swirl faster if there’s a special kind of charge nearby.

name: Hammer Arm
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
description: Stop. Hammer Arm time!

name: High Jump Kick
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 5 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
description: The user launches itself up three stories high to pummel down with a brutal kick. Let’s just trust it’s got a good aim from that distance.

name: Hyperspace Hole
effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Unique. Ignore Defenses. Ignore Shield Moves and Force Field.
description: The laws of physics forbid one object from being in many places at once and from occupying the same space as other bodies. But the user disregards their autorithy.

name: Imprison
effect: Target Self. While the User is on the battlefield, Moves known by the User cannot be used by foes. This effect ends if the User is removed from battle.
description: This move blocks all shared parts of a memory the user is well aware of. Moves, techniques, names, places, people or situations, no one will be able to recall those imprisoned memories.

name: Iron Tail
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
description: With a hardened tail, the Pokémon swings against the foe to make a dent in their armor.

name: Last Resort
effect: Single Target. This Move will fail if the User has not successfully performed all of its known Moves at least once during the battle.
description: The Pokémon may be out of energy, but never out of options.

name: Leech Seed
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of each Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the target ignoring defenses. The User heals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. Grass-Type Pokémon are immune to this Effect. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The foe is infected with seed saplings taking root on their body. As the saplings grow, they'll absorb the vital energy of the foe and send it back to the user.

name: Mach Punch
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Fist Move.
description: The user launches a punch so quickly that it’s barely seen.

name: Magical Leaf
effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
description: The user sends out a floating leaf that will pursue the target until it hits.

name: Flash Cannon
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
description: Through shiny metal parts of their body, the Pokémon reflects a light beam straight into the foe’s eyes.

name: Force Palm
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
description: A powerful open-palm hit that knocks the foe several feet away and may leave them unable to move.

name: Fury Cutter
effect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Cutter Move.
description: The Pokémon uses their claws or scythes to rapidly cut as if shredding paper.

name: Glitzy Glow
effect: Single Target. After dealing damage, activate a Force Field against Special Damage with a Duration of 4 Rounds on the User's side of the Field. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: The user surrounds themselves with a glamorous light and shoots a psychic blast, the glowing particles remain in the field protecting their fabulousness.

name: Gust
effect: Single Target. Wind Move. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyway.
description: The Pokémon flaps their wings and strikes the foe with a swirl of wind. Pokémon in the air may get swept away

name: Heal Bell
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Sound Move. Cure any Status Ailment on the Targets.
description: The soothing chime of a magical bell cleanses all impurities.

name: Heavy Slam
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to he Damage Pool for every 50kg of weight the User is above the target's weight. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
description: The foe is about to confirm if the Pokémon is thick-boned.

name: High Horsepower
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
description: The Pokémon tramples their foe without mercy. Their powerful body could pull a traction vehicle for very long distances.

name: Ice Burn
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Charge Move. Unique. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
description: The user appears to become a block of ice, then it releases themselves from the ice with a devastating explosion. The exploding ice shards and fire blow all over the battlefield.

name: Instruct
effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
description: The Pokémon sends a psychic command to a target, enabling the user to mentally tell them what to do. If you see a Pokémon attacking their own allies... this was it.

name: Knock Off
effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding an Item, Add 2 Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. The Target loses its Held Item afterwards.
description: The Pokémon rudely smacks what their foe was holding.

name: Land's Wrath
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Lethal. Unique.
description: The earth moves on its own, no attacker in sight. The floor crumbles and the ground shakes engulfing its victims. From the rubble, lush trees emerge a short time after.

name: Leech Life
effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
description: The Pokémon clings to their foe, then bites in and starts to suck away its life force.

name: Light Screen
effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Special Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: A barrier of light is created over half of the battlefield, all energy trying to go trough dissolves as it crosses it.

name: Fury Attack
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
description: The Pokémon attacks in a fury, their attacks are uncoordinated but relentless.

name: Growl
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those affected.
description: Either through a menacing attitude or an adorable demeanor, the foe will hesitate to attack the user at full power.

name: Gyro Ball
effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point on Dexterity the Target has that surpasses the User's. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
description: The Pokémon shoots a projectile. Correction: the Pokémon IS the projectile.

name: Heal Block
effect: Area Move. Those affected can't restore HP. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: Through a massive mental onslaught, the Pokémon brings back the memories of pain on everyone around.

name: Hex
effect: Single Target. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
description: The user casts a terrible hex over the target, the effects will be greater if the target is already burdened by an ailment.

name: Hyper Voice
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
description: The user screeches or sings at such high frequencies that anything made of glass will break. The ears of the victims are left in no better state.

name: Ice Beam
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze the Target.
description: The Pokémon shoots a cold beam that reduces all warmth on the environment up to freezing point.

name: Leaf Storm
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce the User's Special by 2.
description: A furious onslaught of sharp leaves blasting against the target. The user gives their all in this attack.

name: Leer
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
description: The vicious glare of a predator that triggers the flight response of their prey.

name: Magic Powder
effect: Single Target. Powder Move. Change the target's Type to Psychic.
description: The Pokémon recites an enchantment and blows a cloud of pink dust on its Target. Afterwards, the target becomes incredibly good at guessing which card you got from a deck.

name: Mat Block
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Shield Move. Reaction 1. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move.
description: The Pokémon uses a mat as a shield.

name: Metal Claw
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Strength by 1.
description: The Pokémon uses the foe as a whetstone.

name: Mist
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Targets cannot have their Attributes or Traits Reduced. Previously Reduced Attributes and Traits remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: A thick layer of mist cloaks a pack of pokémon, those with the intent to trick and weaken them will have to find them first.

name: Needle Arm
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon flails their arms with violence against the foe, the arms have grown thorns that sting like needles.

name: Wood Hammer
effect: Single Target. Recoil.
description: The Pokémon creates a giant wooden hamer and it uses it to smash the foe with such force the hammer also explodes into wood splinters.

name: Future Sight
effect: Single Target. This Move's damage is dealt at the beginning of the next Round. Ignore Shield Moves, Force Field, Cover & Substitute. If the target restires or switches out from battle, the damage will be dealt to the next opponent or to one of its allies.
description: The Pokémon foresees something terrible happening. Although when it tries to see their own future, the images are ever changing.

name: Gravity
effect: Target Battlefield. Remove the immunity to Ground-Type Moves for everyone in the field. Moves that require jumping or flying get an Extra "Low Accuracy 2". Duration 4 Rounds.
description: An invisisible force pulls everyone to the floor keeps them from taking off the ground.

name: Heat Crash
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die of Damage for every 50kgs the User is above the Target. Up to 4 Dice may be added this way.
description: The Pokémon sets themselves ablaze and dives a cannonball against their foe.

name: Headbutt
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Out of battle it may cause a Random encounter when hitting trees and make objects drop from high places.
description: The Pokémon rams against their foe with their head. This Move is perfect to shake down trees when looking for berries, but beware of wild Pokémon nesting at the treetops.

name: Horn Leech
effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
description: The user rams into the foe and uses the leaves growing on their horns to absorb nutrients from it.

name: Glare
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Paralyze the Target.
description: With just one look, the target knows it is about to be someone else’s lunch, fear has them immobilized.

name: Hyper Fang
effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon bites hard into the foe, leaving nasty teeth marks.

name: Hyperspace Fury
effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Ignores the effect of any Force Field or Shield Move active on the foe's side. Reduce the User's Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon opens portals to attack with each one of its arms, bypassing all defenses and making it impossible to escape; however, portals go both ways.

name: Icicle Crash
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon creates a big stalactite on top of the foe and lets it fall on top of it. Sometimes they manage to impale the foe to the ground.

name: Icy Wind
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Wind Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
description: Polar winds sweep through the arena. Everyone starts to shiver and embrace themselves, trying to preserve a bit of warmth.

name: Light Of Ruin
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Recoil. Lethal. Unique.
description: By drawing energy from the Eternal Flower, the Pokémon unleashes all of its hurt. A beautiful light surrounds the area, yet the pain inside of its heart remains.

name: Lovely Kiss
effect: Single Target. Put the Target to Sleep. Pokemon with this Move may forfeit their Beauty score completely, restore 1 Point to their Beauty Score. If the Pokemon forgets this move, restore 1 point to their Beauty Score.
description: A true love’s kiss that could turn any prince into a froakie and put any princess to sleep for a hundred years.

name: Magnet Bomb
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Never Miss. Projectile Move.
description: The user lights the fuse of a magnetized bomb. Guess who is the other magnet?

name: Mega Punch
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Fist Move.
description: The Pokémon packs everything into this punch to pulverize their foe with a single strike.

name: Mimic
effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Replace "Mimic" with the copied Move. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon is a quick learner. They imitate their target’s movements and just like that they get a new set of powers.

name: Head Smash
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
description: Pokémon, angry. Pokémon, smash!

name: Hidden Power
effect: Single Target. This Move will always deal Super-Effective Damage against the Target. If used by the Pokemon #201 Unown. See p. 530
description: Inside every Pokémon lies the key to unlock all kinds of power.

name: Hydro Cannon
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge
description: Those who fear fire’s destructive power have forgotten that water triumphs over the flames every single time.

name: Ice Hammer
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
description: The Pokémon uses its powerful gelid arms and strikes the foe with a swing motion.

name: Icicle Spear
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions.
description: A barrage of icicles shot against the target. They are small but sharp and pointy

name: Karate Chop
effect: Single Target. High Critical.
description: A classic karate technique, thi chop that has been practiced and mastered.

name: Iron Head
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon charges to cure the foe’s iron deficit.

name: Kinesis
effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
description: A basic display of psychic abilities, making objects and other creatures levitate for a short period of time.

name: Lunge
effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
description: The user charges against the foe at full force, not just to knock it down but to restrain it with its many limbs.

name: Low Sweep
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
description: The Pokémon crouches and spins with a kick to the foe’s legs. Leaving them with a limp for the rest of the fight.

name: Magic Coat
effect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Support Moves that would target the user or its side of the field are inflicted to the foe performing the Move or that foe's side of the field instead.
description: Through a swift mind trick the Pokémon trick the foe into pouring their ill intent on itself.

name: Memento
effect: Single Target. The User faints. Reduce by 2 the foe's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
description: As they take their last breath, the Pokémon leaves behind an imprint of regret on their foe.

name: Misty Terrain
effect: Target Battlefield. All Status Ailments and Conditions are cured and no more can be inflicted. Physical & Special Dragon-Type Moves have Power 0. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The battlefield is shrouded by a pink mist that feels protective and soothing. This mist is able to render even the fiercest beasts into calm.

name: Multi-Attack
effect: Single Target. Unique. This Move's type will change to match the User's Main Type.
description: A weird-looking Pokémon charged against its foes, the same attack released different kinds of energy depending on the disk the Pokémon is holding.

name: Leafage
effect: Single Target. Ranged.
description: The user throws leaf darts towards the foe.

name: Mega Kick
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2.
description: A mighty kick. This sheer muscle-power strike can turn concrete pillars into rubble.

name: Megahorn
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal.
description: The Pokémon uses its strong horn(s) to pierce their foe and deal massive damage.

name: Mirror Coat
effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Special Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2. Ignore Defenses.
description: The user gathers the harmful energies around themselves and bounces them back to their source.

name: Mirror Move
effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
description: The Pokémon parrots the target cries and movements. In an almost perfect impersonation that manages to copy its powers.

name: Mud Shot
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
description: By shooting a stream of mud at their target, the user manages to impair their movement.

name: Mud Bomb
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 3 Chance Die to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy rolls of the Target.
description: The Pokémon shoots a ball of mud to burst on their victim’s face in an attempt to blind them.

name: Mystical Fire
effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Special by 1.
description: An iridicent fire that not just burns in the physical world but in the spiritual world as well.

name: Nature's Madness
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Damage Roll is Half of the Target's remaining HP (up to 10 Dice) Rounded down. If the remaining HP of the Target is 1, this move fails. Ignore Defenses.
description: The forces of nature attack as if they had a will of their own. Water will try to drown you, plants will trap you, lightning will come out of nowhere, even your own body will fail you.

name: Night Slash
effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
description: The user looks for a weak spot, tearing the soft flesh apart with a single vile slash of its claws.

name: Origin Pulse
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's immunity to Water-Type Damage. If a Target is "Out of Range" due to using a Move, this Move hits anyways.
description: The Pokémon sends a giant pulse underwater that creates a chain reaction in the tides, creating a series of tsunami waves. Not even water-pokemon can surf through these wild currents.

name: Ominous Wind
effect: Single Target. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The battlefield gets absolutely silent, the only noise is a cold wind draft that gives the target chills and goosebumps. Observing from the shadows, the user rejoices in the fear.

name: Poltergeist
effect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target is Holding an Item or if Items have been used on the Target's side of the field.
description: The Pokémon’s spirit possesses an Item and attacks with that cursed object. It is said that if the Pokémon lingers too long possesing an object, it’ll have trouble getting out.

name: Meteor Assault
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Must Recharge.
description: The Pokémon will make an incredible jump to the sky, then lunge towards the foe at a staggering speed, crashing the ground upon impact. The user is left very tired.

name: Octazooka
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy Rolls of the foe.
description: A jet of black ink shot straight into the foe’s eyes. This Move is hard to aim but returns the favor.

name: Overheat
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Reduce User's Special by 2.
description: A furious scorching flame that turns everything on the user’s radius to ash. This incredible destructive display leaves the user exhausted.

name: Plasma Fists
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. If successful, all Normal-Type Moves of the User will be considered Electric-Type. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The user charges its fists with electricity, upon impact, the charge materializes into plasma that adds an electric element to all of its Normal moves.

name: Pollen Puff
effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. * Or target One Ally. *When this move is used against an ally, it will heal 2 HP instead of damage, Spend 1 Will Point to get this effect.
description: The Pokémon creates a puff of pollen that explodes on the foe's face and gives them a terrible allergy. When consumed, these puffs are sweet and very nutritious.

name: Power-Up Punch
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Increase User's Strength by 1.
description: A punch to test the impact’s surface and adjust the level of strength required to punch through it.

name: Power Trip
effect: Single Target. *Add up to 7 Dice to the Damage Pool of this move for every Attribute increase the user has. (ie The user has 2 increased points on Defense, add 2 Damage dice).
description: In the heat of the battle, the Pokémon gets carried away, reveling on their own power.

name: Psycho Boost
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Unique. Reduce User's Special by 2.
description: The Pokémon releases an explosion of all of its concentrated psychic power in a devastating explosion, afterwards the user will be extremely tired.

name: Psychic Fangs
effect: Single Target. Bite Move. If there is a Force Field on the Target's side of the field, destroy it.
description: The Pokémon bares its fangs to bite the foe, psychic energy begins piercing before the actual fangs make contact.

name: Pyro Ball
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Projectile Move. Ranged. Roll 1 Chance die to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
description: The Pokémon lights a heavy stone on fire and kicks it while it’s ablaze. The hit is pretty heavy already, the fire is just for showing off.

name: Purify
effect: Single Target. Heal a Target's Status Ailment (Burns, Freeze, Paralysis, Poisons, Sleep). *If a Status Ailment was healed this way, the User may spend 1 Will point to restore 2 HP.
description: The target is covered by a gelatinous goo to which every impurity sticks. The user then convinces the target eats this goo, and ends up pleasantly surprised by the sweet flavor.

name: Retaliate
effect: Single Target. *If an Ally fainted during this or the previous Round, add Extra Dice to the damage pool, equal to the user's Loyalty. Up to 5 dice may be added this way. This effect only activates once per fainted Ally.
description: With tears of rage in their eyes, the Pokémon will not let the fall of a friend go without punishment.

name: Rock Climb
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. Out of battle it aids to climb cliffs and mountains with ease.
description: The Pokémon climbs over the foe and rests atop of their head as if it were the top of a mountain. This results confusing for the foe.

name: Mean Look
effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
description: An intense and ever-vigilant stare that surveils all possible paths the foe has to escape.

name: Me First
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Copy Move. Support Moves can't be copied. Unique Moves can't be copied. You may choose another Target(s) for the copied Move.
description: The user anticipates the next Move the target will use and impatiently interrupts to be the first in line.

name: Mirror Shot
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
description: Through a series of reflective surfaces, the Pokémon redirects a beam through unexpected directions. The foe is at a loss; they don’t know if what they see is real or a reflection.

name: Muddy Water
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of those affected.
description: When you can’t see what creatures lurk inside the water, that’s when you know they are the ones that went fishing.

name: Octolock
effect: Single Target. Block. Reduce by 1 the Target's Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The user wraps its tentacles to immobilize the foe. Being so close enables the user to find weak spots.

name: Pluck
effect: Single Target. *If the Target is holding a Berry, Add 1 Die to the Damage pool of this Move. The User also eats the berry and gains its effects.
description: The Pokémon lands on top of the foe and starts pecking them in search for parasites or some other tasty treat to snack on.

name: Phantom Force
effect: Single Target. Charge move. Out of Range while Charging. Lethal. Ignore any Cover, Shield Moves, and/or Force Fields active on the Target.
description: The Pokémon disappears into a dark dimension to infiltrate even the most impenetrable fortress. It may reappear during its next action.

name: Poison Sting
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
description: A tiny stab that causes big troubles.

name: Psych Up
effect: Single Target. The User gets the same Attribute/Trait Increases and Reductions the Target has.
description: The Pokémon mentalizes themselves stronger than anyone. They feel good. They can win. They. Can. Do. This!

name: Quick Guard
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage from a Physical or Special Move with Priority. Negate the Added effects of Reaction and late Reaction Moves targeting the User and Allies.
description: The user reacts instinctively and defends itself and its team mates, nullyfing the effects of the fastest attacks.

name: Razor Shell
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon sharpens a seashell to use as a cutting tool, when this shell manages to cut through the foe’s armor, they’ll finally will have mastered the craft.

name: Reflect
effect: Target the User's side of the field. Force Field. Activate a Force Field against Physical Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: An ethereal mirror-like wall cuts the battlefield in half, bouncing back the impact of most blows.

name: Roar
effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
description: With a potent roar, to make the foe reconsider their intentions.

name: Revenge
effect: Single Target. *If the User has already received Damage this Round, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
description: Best served cold.

name: Mud Slap
effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
description: A mud ball splatters right into the foe’s face, reducing their field of vision.

name: Natural Gift
effect: Single Target. Ranged. The User loes its held berry. *The Type of this Move changes according to the berry used. See more on p. 530
description: The user throws their held berry at the foe, the myriad of flavors has surprisingly different results.

name: Nature Power
effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move is determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530
description: The Pokémon makes use of the terrain and asks for nature's aid in battle.

name: Nightmare
effect: Single Target. Can only be used if the Target has the Sleep Condition. Deal 1 Typeless Damage to the Target after every attempt to resist its Sleep Condition where it doesn't wake up.
description: The user is believed to transport themselves to the land of dreams to torment their victims with vivid night terrors. The vicitms wake up with unexplainable injuries.

name: Pain Split
effect: Single Target. Spend 1 Will Point to activate. *Deal up to 3 Typeless Damage to the Target, Heal 1 HP to the User for every Damage dealt this way. This Move Fails if the User has more than Half HP rounded down. This Move cannot reduce a Target to less than 1 HP.
description: The user channels their pain into the foe to relieve their agony. The foe gets to feel the burn of the damage it has caused.

name: Peck
effect: Single Target.
description: Raise crows and they’ll peck your foe’s eyes.

name: Play Nice
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 1.
description: The Pokémon starts to play with the foe. They are firendly, respectful, and thank the foe for the fun time. The foe does not want to fight, they want to keep playing.

name: Power Trick
effect: Target Self. Switch the User's Strength with their Defense and Special with their Sp. Defense.
description: The Pokémon tricks their own mind to believe their vitality is their power and vice versa.

name: Power Split
effect: Single Target. Average the User's Strength and Special with the Target's, rounded down.
description: Through a mental link both Pokémon are aware of each other strengths, which ends up evening the odds.

name: Psycho Shift
effect: Single Target. Copy all of the User's Status Ailments into the Target. Afterwards, Heal the User from any Status Ailment.
description: Through sheer mental suggestion, the user actually makes their target feel their sickness. The user convinces themselves they are healed afterwards.

name: Razor Leaf
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Cutter Move. Ranged. High Critical.
description: The user sends out a barrage of sharp razor-like leaves. “Death by a thousand cuts” would be the best depiction.

name: Reversal
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
description: The user gathers their mettle to block away the pain and focus only on hitting harder.

name: Rock Tomb
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
description: The pokémon buries their foe prematurely, but it’ll be good practice for the real thing.

name: Sand Attack
effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
description: Sand to the eyes! A dirty tactic in more ways than one.

name: Seed Bomb
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Projectile Move.
description: A giant seed is hurled against the target, the hit is not what knocks them down, the tree that explodes suddenly out of the seed is what does.

name: Shadow Punch
effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Fist Move.
description: The Pokémon punches the air, inadvertently, their shadow delivers the punch through the foe’s own shadow. This move is impossible to predict.

name: Nuzzle
effect: Single Target. Paralyze the foe.
description: The Pokémon gives a cute nuzzle at their target, it looks adorable until you see the sparks.

name: Pin Missile
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions.
description: The Pokémon shoots a barrage of stingers or spikes that pierce like needles.

name: Photon Geyser
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. This Move's Damage Pool, can be rolled with either Strength or Special Attribute, dealing Physical or Special Damage respectively. Choose whatever is most convenient for the user.
description: The Pokémon attacks with a large pillar of light that comes out from they stand, either the blazing energy or the crushing strike are enough to knock foes out.

name: Pound
effect: Single Target.
description: The user pounds the target’s head. Simple

name: Power Gem
effect: Single Target.
description: With a crystal gem, the Pokémon will always save the day!

name: Power Whip
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2.
description: A thick vine full of thorns is waved as a whip against the enemy. As devastating as the blow would be, the incoming attack is easily percieved by the foe.

name: Present
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. *Target rolls 1 die with a 50-50 chance of dealing 2 Set Damage to the Target or Restoring 2 HP to the Target.
description: The user hands out a lovely present box. Time to find out if the foe has been naugthy or nice

name: Rock Blast
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Move.
description: A rock shrapnel, the user shoots tiny bullet-like pebbles.

name: Rock Throw
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged.
description: Back in the day, this was a common form of amusement amongst Pokémon and children alike.

name: Sandstorm
effect: Target Battlefield. Wind Move. Activate Sandstorm Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: A fierce sandstorm starts raging all around the battlefield. Cover your eyes, nose and face! The rough sand will hurt you!

name: Seed Flare
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. Roll 4 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
description: Shaymin releases an explosion of pollen and seeds that the foe cannot shake off, leaving it vulnerable. Over time, these seeds will grow into gigantic trees of life.

name: Simple Beam
