effect: Single Target. Change the Target's Ability to "Simple". Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
description: A weak mental beam that doesn’t hurt or confuse the target but it does change their view of life as they start to take a simpler apporach to things.

name: Smart Strike
effect: Single Target. Never Miss. Lethal.
description: The user stabs the foe using one of their sharp horns with astounding precision. The resulting wound is very deep and needs stitches immediately

name: Solar Blade
effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Cutter Move. If Sunny Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge action. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm or Hail/Snowy Weather, this Move takes two actions to Charge.
description: The Pokémon focuses the sunlight on its sharp leaves, then releases the energy with a shattering cut.

name: Spite
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Will to 1 point. Reset any effects it got from spending Will Points.
description: The target feels overwhelmend by feelings of dread.

name: Odor Sleuth
effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa. Out of battle, Add successes of this Move to any roll for Tracking targets.
description: The Pokémon uses their keen sense of smell to corner the foe and find it when it tries to scurry away

name: Petal Blizzard
effect: Area Move. Ranged. Wind Move.
description: A raging blizzard of petals and leaves sweeps through the entire area, leaving a pleasant floral scent and destruction in its wake.

name: Poison Tail
effect: Single Target. High Critical. Roll 1 Chance Die to Poison the Target.
description: A sharp edge dipped in venom—an attack in bad blood in all senses of the word.

name: Powder
effect: Single Target. Powder Move. The next time the Target uses a Fire-Type Move, Roll Typeless Damage Dice equal to that Move's power, ignore defenses.
description: The foe gets covered by a very flammable powder, the smallest source of fire will ignite it with explosive results.

name: Psycho Cut
effect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical. Cutter Move.
description: The user sends out an invisible sword made with psychic energy that slashes targets even if they are far away

name: Punishment
effect: Single Target. *Add up to 7 Dice to the Damage Pool of the Move for every Attribute increase the target has. (ie The target has 2 increased points on Strength, add 2 Damage dice).
description: You shouldn’t have done that...

name: Razor Wind
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Charge Move. High Critical. Cutter Move.
description: The Pokémon sways the winds while charging what appears to be an invisible blade made of pressurized air. The wind slices everything it touches as if it were a razor.

name: Rapid Spin
effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User and/or their side of the field.
description: The Pokémon makes a swift spin to strike at the foe and in the process everything laying close to the user is scattered out of the battlefield.

name: Revelation Dance
effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances, and STAB accordingly.
description: The Pokémon performs a dance, the dance’s energy influences the Type of this Move.

name: Roar Of Time
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge. Lethal. Unique. If successful, the target can't take any action unless they spend 1 Will point per action attempted. Duration 1 Round.
description: Through a terrifying roar, Dialga bounds the forces of time on a single area, the unfortunate target will be trapped in a time warp, growing old in a matter of miliseconds.

name: Role Play
effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
description: The Pokémon is a great actor. Their impersonations are really good! ...maybe a bit too good.

name: Sacred Sword
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Ignore Defenses.
description: The user slashes at its target with a mighty blade. Theres no hide nor armor thick enough to resist its valorous steel.

name: Searing Shot
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. Projectile Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on those affected.
description: The User torches everything around itself in a sudden burst of scarlet flames. Everything is brought to cinders in a matter of seconds.

name: Shadow Sneak
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
description: The user sneaks through the darkness and strikes by coming out of the target’s shadow. The Pokémon is able travel freely through the shadow realm.

name: Oblivion Wing
effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Unique.
description: A dark wind rises, turning everything it touches into dust to be scattered until nothing remains. People, Pokémon, plants, everything fades like a distant memory.

name: Parabolic Charge
effect: Area Move. The User restore HP equal to half the damage to one Target, rounded down.
description: The Pokémon lets loose a big electric charge from its body. The charge comes back to it even bigger.

name: Petal Dance
effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
description: The Pokémon casts a huge cluster of petals to dance in the wind; they let nature run its course, as the wind will choose who will take the devastating blow.

name: Play Rough
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
description: The Pokémon and their foe start a playful wrestle that soon escalates into a furious wrestling match.

name: Poison Powder
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Poison the Target.
description: A cloud of noxius powder that immediately sends the target’s immune system into overdrive.

name: Power Swap
effect: Single Target. Whole Scene Duration. Switch the User's Strength and Special with the Target's.
description: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to steal its power and implant on them the idea of their own frailty.

name: Psystrike
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. This Move is resisted with the Foe's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
description: Through sheer psychic power, the user materializes its energy to deal a heavy strike to its foe.

name: Quick Attack
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Out of battle, double the Pokemon's movement speed.
description: An attackas fight as lightning.

name: Quash
effect: Single Target. Target's will go last in the Initiative Order. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. If used again, the previous Target has their order in the initiative restored.
description: The user represses the foe through intimidation so it thinks twice before acting.

name: Sketch
effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Replace "Sketch" with the copied Move. Permanent Duration.
description: The Pokémon draws a rough sketch of their target performing a Move and through their art studies they manage to learn that same Move in the process.

name: Solar Beam
effect: Single Target. Charge Move. If Sunny Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge action. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm or Hail/Snowy Weather, this Move takes two actions to Charge.
description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight but instead of being absorbed it is sot as a devastating beam of light instead.

name: Spike Cannon
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Successive Actions. Projectile Move.
description: The Pokémon shoots wave after wave of hundreds of tiny spikes.

name: Stealth Rock
effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Rock-Type Damage. This effect does not stack.
description: The Pokémon hides a trap of sharp rocks that are launched at the victim before they even realize what even happened.

name: Stomp
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Die to Flinch the Target. Targets under the effects of the Move "Minimize" are vulnerable.
description: Stomping the foe with strong feet. Perfect to squish nasty little bugs.

name: Outrage
effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
description: The true nature of dragon-types unleashed. The user is consumed by a primal fury that won’t stop until everything has ben razed to the ground. Afterwards the Pokémon is confused.

name: Payback
effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round.
description: Some say the best revenge is a successful and happy life, but not this Pokémon.

name: Pika Papow
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point of Happiness on the User. Up to 5 Dice may be added this way. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: The User lets out its energy in the form of a lightning strike, the happier the user feels the more energized it will be.

name: Poison Gas
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Poison those affected.
description: A thick cloud of toxic gas that causes violent coughs and red eyes.

name: Poison Jab
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
description: The Pokémon is set on injecting venom directly into the foe’s bloodstream. They can do it the easy way or the hard way.

name: Psychic
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
description: The most iconic Psychic attack, the foe starts floating in the air and its swayed around by telekinesis as their mental barrier crumbles.

name: Pursuit
effect: Single Target. *If a Target hit by this Move is recalled, attempts to Run Away, uses a Switcher Move or is the Target of a Switcher Move, Deal 2 Typeless Damage to it. Outside of battle, aid in catching a fleeing target.
description: The Pokémon is relentless in its pursuit of their target, striking it just as it believed it had escaped.

name: Relic Song
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Unique. Roll 1 Chance Die to put the foe to Sleep. If successful, the User may choose to change its form afterwards.
description: The user sings and dances to a melody so beautiful you won’t notice you were crying while listening to it.

name: Rock Smash
effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Defense by 1.
description: A hit powerful enough to destroy rocks and crack armor.

name: Self Destruct
effect: Area Move. Lethal. Ranged. The User faints.
description: It’s not about winning or losing, some pokémon just want to see the world burn.

name: Sheer Cold
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Ranged. Deal Damage to the Target equal to its Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
description: The Pokémon reaches an absolute zero by being freezed from the inside out. Urgent medical attention is required.

name: Skill Swap
effect: Single Target. Switch the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. This affect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. Unique Abilities can't be switched.
description: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to assimilate the traits of that species while make the foe think it is a member from another species. The foe gets an identity crisis afterwards.

name: Soak
effect: Single Target. Change the Target's Type to Water. (ie Charizard was Fire/Flying, after this Move their Type will be Water) Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
description: The foe gets soaking wet, they should stay away from electric outlets and thirsty plants.

name: Powder Snow
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected.
description: A light layer of snow flakes covers the foes, as the layers pile up the possibilities to be trapped into the snow increase.

name: Psyshock
effect: Single Target. This Move is resisted with the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense.
description: The shock is mental, the blow is real.

name: Rock Slide
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
description: Don’t worry, even if you are not the fastest one in the race, you can still win by a landslide.

name: Rock Wrecker
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Ranged. Projectile Move. Must Recharge.
description: A giant boulder is blasted like a cannon ball towards the target. Leaving a path of destruction and a subsequent explosion as the boulder crashes. Let the pokémon catch their breath afterwards.

name: Rolling Kick
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon jumps in the air and spins with one leg extended to land an impressive kick against their foe.

name: Rollout
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
description: When the foe sees this Pokémon rollin’ they’ll be hatin’.

name: Rototiller
effect: Target Battlefield. Increase by 1 the Strength and Special of all Grass-Type Pokemon.
description: The Pokémon digs around the battlefield to soften the soil and make it ideal for harvest.

name: Secret Power
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Inflict Status determined by the environment or active Terrain. See more on p. 530
description: There’s energy all around us, hidden secretly in the most incospicuous places. This Move makes use of that energy bringing the secret to light.

name: Seismic Toss
effect: Single Target. Roll Fight-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
description: The foe gets launched up to the sky, then falls face-first into the ground making it tremble. The stronger the user, the higher the launch.

name: Screech
effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
description: A mighty screech will make the target cover its ears instead of covering its flanks.

name: Shadow Claw
effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical.
description: The Pokémon uses their ghostly claws to slash through their foe’s body tearing not their flesh but their soul directly.

name: Shell Trap
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Late Reaction 3. This Move's damage is only rolled the next time the User is hit with a Non-Ranged Physical attack.
description: The Pokémon apparently just buries underground, but secretly prepares their shell to detonate; anyone who steps on it will be blown to pieces.

name: Sky Drop
effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Out of Range while Charging. Vulnerable while charging to: Thunder / Twister / Sky Uppercut / Gust / Hurricane / Smack Down. Flinch Target. If Target is Flying-Type or too heavy to carry, this Move fails. See Strength chart on p. 532.
description: The Pokémon clutches their foe and starts flying up high, then drops the foe from a decent altitude. Let gravity handle this one.

name: Smokescreen
effect: Single Target. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Target.
description: The Pokémon covers the foe in a cloud of smoke to impair their visibility to make it easier to hide and/or cover their escape.

name: Sludge
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
description: What is it with these Poison Types and covering their victims with all kinds of organic waste?!

name: Strength
effect: Outside of battle, using this move allows the Pokemon to lift double the normal weight it should be able to.
description: The Pokemon strains its muscles to go beyond their own limits.

name: Scratch
effect: Single Target.
description: The Pokémon uses their sharp claws to scratch the enemy. Nothing fancy but it works.

name: Signal Beam
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the foe.
description: The Pokémon shoots a buzzing beam that leaves makes the foe head towards bright lights like a dazzled moth.

name: Skull Bash
effect: Single Target. Charge Move. While this Move is charging, Increase the User's Defense by 1.
description: The user withdraws into their shell, after a few seconds of them not moving, the foe goes to inspect and the user pops their head out in in a devastating strike.

name: Sizzly Slide
effect: Single Target. Inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. If the User of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: The user slides on the floor as if it was ice-skating, only there is no ice, only a raging fire.

name: Snap Trap
effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The user is so flat that you can barely see it in the tall grass. Waiting for an unsuspecting prey to get close enough to use its body as a snare trap. It won’t let go until its prey faints.

name: Snipe Shot
effect: Single Target. High Critical. Ignore effects from Moves, Items or Abilities that would prevent this Move from targeting the foe.
description: The user shoots a piercing water jet with incredible precision.

name: Spark
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
description: The user engulfs itself with statc electricity then charges with a solid tackle against the foe. Sparks fly, very literally.

name: Spirit Shackle
effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
description: While attacking, the user sneakily binds its foe’s shadow to the ground, restricting its movement and making it unable to escape.

name: Spit Up
effect: Single Target. The user must have previously used the Move "Stockpile", otherwise this Move will fail. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: After stockpiling, the Pokémon spits the stored energy as a mighty beam. The user returns to their original size afterwards.

name: Sticky Web
effect: Target's Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of Foes that enter the battlefield. Pokemon with Immunity to Ground are not affected.
description: The Pokémon quickly covers the arena with a sticky web, newly arrived foes will have trouble moving with ease.

name: Stone Edge
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
description: Obsidian shards are sent out against the foe. This rock may be brittle but is the sharpest in the world.

name: Synchronoise
effect: Area Move. Sound Move. Choose one Type (Fire, Poison, Steel, etc.). This move only affects those with that Type.
description: Each type of energy is contained by a thin layer of particles. With the right vibration frequency, that thin layer can be shattered like glass.

name: Tar Shot
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1. For the Whole Scene, Fire-Type Moves deal Super-Effective damage against the Target.
description: The Pokémon gushes a blob of black tar over its foe. The unfortunate victim can barely move afterwards, keep it away from fire sources, tar is extremely flammable.

name: Thunder Wave
effect: Single Target. Paralyze the Target.
description: A series of electric waves hit the target, their voltage is too weak to cause much harm but muscles will get cramped for hours.

name: Scary Face
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 2.
description: When a Pokémon looks at you like THAT, you know you gotta thread carefully around them.

name: Shadow Bone
effect: Single Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Reduce the Foe's Defense by 1.
description: The bone that this Pokémon uses as a weapon contains a spirit, that spirit may cling into a victim, creating openings for its master.

name: Shadow Ball
effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
description: Dark matter and shadows are used as a projectile against the foe, bringing out memories of their deepest fears.

name: Smelling Salts
effect: Single Target. *If the Target is Paralyzed, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move. After dealing damage, cure the Target's Paralysis
description: The Pokémon uses strong smelling salts to purify the arena or to throw into the foe’s face. Any paralized Pokémon gets a sudden jolt at the powerfull smell.

name: Sludge Wave
effect: Area Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Poison those affected.
description: A wave of black water spouts all around the user. It’s knee-high and rising. Fighting in such unsanitary conditions is not a good idea.

name: Spikes
effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Pokemon entering the battle Receive 1 Typeless Damage. This effect does not stack. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
description: Sharp and pointy spikes are scattered around the field, if you don’t watch your step the spikes will dig on your feet.

name: Steam Eruption
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Target.
description: In less than a second, the sound of steam boiling over a raging engine thunders through the ears of the foe before it is shot up in the sky by a scalding geyser.

name: Struggle Bug
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Special of those affected.
description: The Pokémon sends a distress signal through its antennae to interrupt the foe’s concentration.

name: Swift
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Never Miss.
description: The Pokémon shoots a burst of star-shaped sparkles at a blinding speed.

name: Teatime
effect: Area Move. Those Affected will eat their held berries and berries on their Trainer's Bag without gaining their effects. Outside of battle, it will diffuse violent intentions for a few minutes.
description: The Pokémon gathers everyone for a cup of delicious tea, not eating a snack along with it would be a waste.

name: Tearful Look
effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Special.
description: The Pokémon’s eyes start watering as if it were about to cry, it’s foe is moved by the tears and loses its will to fight.

name: Thunder Shock
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
description: The most basic electric attack, charge, release, and shock! Just don’t point it to any electric device.

name: Thunder
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target. Rain Weather eliminates Low Accuracy. Sunny Weather increases it to Low Accuracy 4. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce", or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
description: The Pokémon commands the skies to send a giant lightning bolt to a specific point. Difficult to command under clear skies, lethal during a storm. Flying Pokémon are specially vulnerable.

name: Trick Room
effect: Target the Battlefield. Invert the order of Initiative. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: Reality inside the battlefielfield is distorted, time bends and flows differently for everyone. Those who don’t rush through manage to adapt easier.

name: Scald
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. If a Target is Out of Range due to using the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways.
description: The user shoots boiling water at the foe, immediately causing blisters.

name: Secret Sword
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Apply the Target's Defense instead of its Sp. Defense to resist the Damage from this Move.
description: An invisible wave cuts through the target, you can feel its sharp edge but you cannot see it.

name: Shock Wave
effect: Single Target. Never Miss.
description: A series of lightning bolts rise through the floor towards the sky, it is impossible to predict where they are coming from.

name: Sky Uppercut
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Low Accuracy 1. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
description: The user attacks with an uppercut, throwing the foe skyward with lots of force. Even flyers are not safe from this attack.

name: Sonic Boom
effect: Single Target. This Move always inflict 1 Typeless damage. Ignore Defenses, Force Fields, Shield Moves, Cover, Out of Range, Type or Ability that would prevent this damage.
description: The Pokémon makes use of a small but very destructive shock that goes through any wall, layer or wall.

name: Spider Web
effect: Target Foe's Side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon moves stealthily and without raising suspicion. By the time the enemy realizes it, the entire field is covered in cobwebs.

name: Speed Swap
effect: Single Target. Switch the User's Dexterity with the Target's.
description: This move allows the user to release its power. If the user has any boosts, the damage is increased.

name: String Shot
effect: Targets All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected.
description: The foe gets tangled in a fine silk string shot by the user. This silk can also be used to make fine clothes.

name: Sunny Day
effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Sunny Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The Pokémon will call for the sun to shine brighter, increasing the heat of the arena. This Move doesn’t work at night, indoors, or underground/water.

name: Taunt
effect: Single Target. The Target cannot perform Support Moves (Support Maneuvers may still be performed). Duration 4 Rounds.
description: Through tease and mockery, the foe is enraged to the point it stops thinking clearly.

name: Thunderbolt
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
description: A solid electric shock. A discharge of nearly 10,000 volts that can knock out most foes and destroy electrical devices.

name: Tri Attack
effect: Single Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Freeze the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
description: The foe has three problems and this Move is all of them.

name: Trop Kick
effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 1.
description: The user strikes with an intense and alluring kick.

name: Water Sport
effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Fire-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Fire-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: A single drop of water can’t put off a raging fire, but what is the ocean but a collection of drops.

name: Silver Wind
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, and Sp. Defense.
description: A beautiful but dangerous wind that blows a silver powder against the foe. The performance may give the user a big confidence boost.

name: Slam
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1.
description: Everybody get up, it’s time to slam now.

name: Slash
effect: Single Target. Lethal. High Critical. Cutter Move.
description: The Pokémon uses the sharpest part of their body as a blade to tear and slash with vicious intent.

name: Snatch
effect: Single Target. Reaction 6. Remove any Increase/Reduction on the Foe's Attributes, Active Shield Moves, Healing effects on the Foe, or effects on its side of the field; and place them on the User instead. See p. 531 for more info.
description: The user takes notice of the good stuff on the other side and quickly takes it for themselves. Finders keepers, losers weepers!

name: Sparkly Swirl
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Heal any Status Ailment on the User and Allies in Range. If the user of the Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: The Pokémon unleashes a swirling and glittery energy that releases a pleasant aroma that soothes the body and has healing properties.

name: Spacial Rend
effect: Single Target. High Critical. Lethal. Unique. If successful, reduce 5 Success from all Accuracy rolls of the Target. Whole scene duration.
description: With a flicker of its claws, Palkia defragments the space around its foe. Those who survive rarely do preserve their original shape much less move or fuction as they should.

name: Steamroller
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch Target.
description: The user curls up and rolls at full speed against the foe with the intention to swat them on the ground.

name: Super Fang
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll Normal-Type Damage Dice equal to Half of the Target's remaining HP. Up to 10 Dice may be rolled this way. Ignore Defenses.
description: The Pokémon jumps to bite a chunk off their Target with their mighty fangs. After each bite there’s less and less foe to take chunks off.

name: Surf
effect: Area Move. If a Target is out of range due to the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways. Out of battle, allows the Pokemon to travel the sea for long distances.
description: The Pokémon calls forward a large wave of seawater to ride, most Pokémon get washed out as they did not bring a surfboard.

name: Tickle
effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Defense.
description: Whoever said laughter is the best therapy lied.

name: Twineedle
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Double Action. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Poison the Target each hit.
description: The Pokémon makes a double stab using a poison-infused sting, claw, or spikes.

name: Volt Switch
effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for the User.
description: The user shoots a wave of electric rings that allow it to reteat to safety at the speed of lightning.

name: Wide Guard
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the Targets would receive from Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Moves on the Targets.
description: The Pokémon uses their whole body to provide shelter and protection to everyone they can. They are the rock on which others stand.

name: Zing Zap
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the foe.
description: The user hurls itself as a zig-zaging ball of electricity that explodes on contact, this leaves the foe unable to move for a few seconds.

name: Spore
effect: Single Target. Powder Move. Put the Target to Sleep.
description: A very potent somniferous spore. Dangerous to inhale as it could make you sleep for days.

name: Steel Beam
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Recoil.
description: A concentrated ray of light that is capable of melting even the thickest steel plates. Unfortunately, the user is also made of steel.

name: Steel Wing
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 1 Chance Die to Increase the User's Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon has weather-proofed wings that cut flying times, cut through the air, and, most importantly, cut through their foes.

name: Strength Sap
effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Strength by 1. Heal 1 HP to the user. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate.
description: The Pokémon looks for a weak point on its foe, then feeds on its vital energy. The foe is left feeling feeble.

name: Strange Steam
effect: Single Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
description: The user releases an addictive and sweet-smelling steam. Do not be fooled as it is mildly toxic with nasty side-effects.

name: Sunsteel Strike
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. If anything on the foe's side would prevent this move frm dealing (Pokemon Type, Abilities, Shield Moves, Weather or Force Fields), ignore it. This Move cannot be Clashed.
description: You suddenly stop in your tracks as you see a bright and blinding light coming towards you at great speed. You do not see what hits you before it’s all darkness.

name: Tackle
effect: Single Target.
description: The user charges to tackle their foe, it gets the job done.

name: Take Down
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
description: Through a reckless grapple, the Pokémon smashes the foe into the ground, usually falling along with it.

name: Thrash
effect: Target Random Foe. Rampage.
description: The Pokémon becomes a wild thing and the rumpus has started.

name: Topsy-Turvy
effect: Single Target. Increased Attributes on the Target become Reductions instead and vice versa.
description: Though clever manipulation the Pokémon switches their foe’s morality compass. Bad things become good and bad things become bad.

name: Toxic Thread
effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Dexterity by 1. Poison the Foe.
description: The user shoots a sticky thread that entangles around the foe, the thread is also laced with a potent toxin that will poison the foe on contact.

name: Trick-Or-Treat
effect: Single Target. Add the Ghost Type to the Target's Type. (ie Pikachu will now be "Electric/Ghost", Charizard will not be "Fire/Flying/Ghost") If the Target already has a third Type attached, replace it.
description: The user invites their foe to go trick-or-treating. The foe puts on a ghost costume that cannot be removed without an exorcism or help from the Pokémon center.

name: Trump Card
effect: Single Target. *If the User's Will Points are at half or less, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool. **If the User's Will points are depleted, add 8 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move instead.
description: You can’t give up until you have given your all. And just as everyone thinks you are done for, you still the last card in your hand.

name: Uproar
effect: Target Random Foe. Sound Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Pokemon will be cured of the Sleep Status. Duration 1 Round.
description: Shouts, screams, and loud music... What does a Pokémon have to do here for a peaceful night of sleep?

name: Vital Throw
effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. Never Miss.
description: You don’t need to go to the enemy, let them come to you.

name: Spirit Break
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Special by 1.
description: Sticks and stones may break your bones but words will too.

name: Splash
effect: Target Self. No effect.
description: Oh, for the love of Arceus...

name: Storm Throw
effect: Single Target. This Move is always considered to be a Critical Hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.
description: The user throws its foe with a special technique, the foe lands right on their weak spot.

name: Submission
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Recoil.
description: The Pokémon wrestles their foe to subdue it, but the foe will put up a fight before they let it happen.

name: Sucker Punch
effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. *This move can only be used as a Late Reaction; and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
description: The Pokémon takes advantage of their foe preparing to attack to unleash a dirty surprise blow.

name: Tail Whip
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those affected.
description: The Pokémon whips their tail in such an adorable way the foes let their guard down.

name: Teeter Dance
effect: Area Move. Confuse those affected.
description: The Pokémon dances with wobbly movements and erratic spins. The spectators don’t know what to make of these modern choreographies.

name: Thousand Arrows
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's immunity to Ground. Remove the immunity to Ground-Type Moves of those affected. Whole Scene Duration.
description: Out of nowhere, pointy shards come raining from the sky towards the foes. Even flying creatures will fall to the ground if they are knocked by them. Take cover, this is gonna hurt.

name: Trick
effect: Single Target. The User and the Target switch their Held Item. If only one Pokemon is holding an Item, it gives it away.
description: The user controls its target’s mind to make them do a simple non-hostile action, such as walking or handing an item. Although some Pokémon use simple sleigh of hand.

name: V-Create
effect: Single Target. Unique. Reduce by 1 the User's Dexterity, Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The user slams its foe with a V-Shaped flame on its forehead, upon impact, it detonates a terrible explosion and leaves the user pretty vulnerable afterwards.

name: Veevee Volley
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point of Happiness on the User, up to 5 Dice may be added this way. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: Long sessions playing Volley ball with your Pokémon make it very happy. During battle, it just replaces the ball with a foe.

name: Vine Whip
effect: Single Target.
description: The Pokémon uses its body vines to give the foe a good smack. These vines can be as long as 20 feet and quite surdy as ropes.

name: Weather Ball
effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. *If there is a weather condition on the field, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. This Move's type will change according to the Weather. Sun/Fire, Rain/Water, Hail or Snow/Ice, Sand/Rock, Wind/Flying.
description: A ball created out of the forces of the weather. Today’s forecast is cloudy with a chance of pain!

name: X-Scissor
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move.
description: The Pokémon uses its scythes or clawa as if they were a pair of scissors to cut through the foe.

name: Zap Cannon
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 4. Lethal. Paralyze the Target. Projectile Move.
description: A dreadful but erratic bombardment of electric explosions, getting hit would be devastating.

name: Stun Spore
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Paralyze the Target.
description: A cloud of paralyzing pollen that affects the nerves and cramps the muscles of those who inhale it.

name: Sweet Kiss
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Confuse the Target.
description: The Pokémon timidly approaches the foe and plants a delicate kiss on its cheek then quickly retreats giggling. The foe struggles to understand the meaning of this.

name: Switcheroo
effect: Single Target. The User and the Target switch their Held Item. If only one Pokemon is holding an Item, it gives it away.
description: The Pokémon uses a bit of sleigh of hand to switch their Held Item with the target’s, who don’t even notice what happened.

name: Thousand Waves
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Ranged. Unique. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
description: Solid ground becomes a sandtrap, cracked earth will close to ensnare your feet. It’s as if the land itself wanted to trap you. There is no attacker nor escape in sight.

name: Triple Kick
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Triple Action. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the third hit.
description: The good ol’ one-two with an even better twist! They never see that last hit coming.

name: Vacuum Wave
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1.
description: Using their chi as a vacuum, the Pokémon pulls the foe closer, the foe gets hurt by the sudden force wave on its body

name: Venom Drench
effect: Target All Foes in Range. *If the affected are already Poisoned or becomes Poisoned in the same Round this Move was used, Reduce by 1 their Strength, Special and Dexterity.
description: The user weakens the foe’s already compromised immune systems.

name: Thief
effect: Single Target. The User steals the Target's Held Item. If the User already has a Held Item, this effect fails.
description: The Pokémon hits their foe and seizes the moment to take some pocket change from its wallet as well.

name: Wake-Up Slap
effect: Single Target. *If the foe has the Sleep Status, Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. Wake up the foe after dealing damage.
description: Wakey wakey, sleepy head!

name: Water Gun
effect: Single Target.
description: The fastest water gun in town. No enemy will remain dry

name: Venoshock
effect: Single Target. *If the Target is already Poisoned, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
description: The Pokémon identifies the weakest prey and makes an opportunistic shot.

name: Wrap
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
description: The Pokémon swiftly entangles their foe in a squeezing lock to prevent their escape.

name: Wonder Room
effect: Target the Battlefield. Everyone on the Battlefield will have their Defense and Sp. Defense calculated with Insight instead of Vitality. If using Insight as Sp. Defense optional rule, swap the calculation. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The battlefield is now a space that puts the mind to the test. A resilient mind will be a resilient body, but if the mind is weak the body will feel frail and feeble.

name: Whirlpool
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion. Duration 4 Rounds. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive", this Move hits anyways.
description: The foe is swallowed inside of a violent swirling whirlpool. Trapping them on the violent currents, barely managing to stay afloat.

name: Swagger
effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Strength by 2. Confuse the Target.
description: The Pokémon’s arrogant and mocking attitude enrage their foe and make it lose focus in battle.

name: Techno Blast
effect: Single Target. Lethal. *If Genesect is performing this Move, this Move's type may change to: Fire, Ice, Water, or Electric depending on the Driver it has as Held Item.
description: A laser briefly beams away from the Pokémon, whatever it hits explodes a second later. This move can be modified with the right programing of a computer.

name: Torment
effect: Single Target. The Target cannot use any of the Moves it used during the last Round. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The Pokémon bullies their foe to the point of torment where they cannot keep using their strategy without feeling bad about it.

name: Twister
effect: Target all foes in Range. Wind Move. Roll 2 Chance dice to Flinch those affected. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop" this Move hits anyways.
description: A raging twister embedded with a dragon’s fury. No one wants to be trapped in this fearsome spiral, which almost touches the sky.

name: U-Turn
effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for User.
description: A bait and switch move, where the user strikes then makes a sudden u-turn back to safety.

name: Vice Grip
effect: Single Target. Lethal.
description: The Pokémon traps the foe with its pincers or jaws and applies pressure that will leave a nasty bruise.

name: Water Shuriken
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Successive Actions.
description: The best ninjas attack swiftly and undetected, after the deed is done, no evidence is left but an inconspicuous puddle of water.

name: Volt Tackle
effect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 3 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
description: The Pokémon charges their most powerful electric attack but instead of releasing it, they run at top speed to crash agains their foe with it.

name: Waterfall
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon swims with such force and speed that it could even swim upwards in a waterfall.

name: Will-O-Wisp
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. Using this Move against the same Target increases the Burn Degree.
description: The user calls upon an eerie blue flame made with the souls of the departed. They appear harmless until they have you surrounded.

name: Wild Charge
effect: Single Target. Recoil. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
description: The Pokémon surrounds itself with lightning then recklessly charges against their target.

name: Worry Seed
effect: Single Target. Replace the Target's Ability with "Insomnia". Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
description: The user plants the seed of doubt and uncertainty on its foe. The foe becomes such a worrywart that they can’t even sleep at night.

name: Wring Out
effect: Single Target. Lethal. *Remove 1 Dice from the Damage Pool for every missing HP on the target. Up to 4 Dice may be removed this way.
description: The Pokémon quite literally squeezes the life out of their foe. But to do this effectively they require to be in top condition.

name: Zippy Zap
effect: Single Target. Reaction 2. This Move is always considered a Critical Hit and gets the proper Bonus for it. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: The user zips and zaps from one place to another to strike the foe moving so fast it appears to be teleporting, leaving almost no time to react.

name: Amnesia
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Sp. Defense by 2.
description: No thoughts. Head empty

name: Aqua Ring
effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon coats themselves in fresh water.

name: Autotomize
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2. Halve the User's weight.
description: Rotating parts and tiny gears, the Pokémon works like a welloiled machine.

name: Baneful Bunker
effect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the User would receive from a Damaging Move. *If the Foe used a Non-Ranged Physical Move against the user, Poison the foe.
description: The user encloses themselves inside a sturdy shell covered by poisonous barbs, if a barb pinches the Target’s skin, the wound will start to fester

name: Belly Drum
effect: Target Self. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignore defenses. Increase User's Strengt by 3.
description: With an angry war cry the user hits their belly as drums of war.

name: Charge
effect: Target Self. Add 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of thenext Damaging Electric-Type Move the User performs.
description: The user gathers electricity and stores it to make its attacks more powerful. You may also use them as a living battery for your phone.

name: Clangorous Soul
effect: Target Self. User deals Damage Dice to itself equal to Half of its Total HP rounded down. Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The Pokémon shakes its scales around, to sharpen, shed, and rearrange them. It’s a bit rough, but in the end the Pokémon feels more focused for battle.

name: Cosmic Power
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The Pokémon elevates their cosmos to enhance their physical and mental fortitude.

name: Defense Curl
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1. Increase by 1 the Power of the Moves "Ice Ball" & "Rollout".
description: The user curls into a ball to protect themselves when they feel threatened.

name: Dragon Dance
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Dexterity.
description: The user performs a vigorous and mystical dance to boost their fighting spirit and reflexes.

name: Wish
effect: Target Self / Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. This move has its effect at the beginning of the Next Round. If the User is switched it will heal whoever takes their place.
description: When you wish upon a star it makes no difference who you are, anything your heart desires will come to you.

name: Water Spout
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. *Reduce 1 Die from the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be removed this way.
description: This Move alone may be the reason the earth is 70% water.

name: Zen Headbutt
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: The Pokémon uses both their mental and physical prowess in a questionable yet effective “psychic” strike.

name: Bulk Up
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
description: The Pokémon showcase their muscles through poses that highlight their fitness and bodybuilding discipline.

name: Coil
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense score and Accuracy Pools.
description: The Pokémon curls up into themselves. Foes soon realize this is not the position of a prey in hiding, but of a hunter about to spit their venom.

name: Conversion 2
effect: Target Self. Unique. After being dealt damage by a Physical or Special Move, change the User's Main Type to a Type resistant to that Move. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon downloads data from a Move that was used against it and changes their code to resist future attacks.

name: Conversion
effect: Target Self. Unique. Change the User's Main Type at random. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon downloads data from their database to add into their own code.

name: Defend Order
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense and Sp. Defense by 1.
description: A swarm of bugs flies around the user, creating a barrier to protect their swarm queen from damage.

name: Detect
effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special move. Negate the Added Effcts of Any Moves that target the user.
description: The Pokémon detects the intentions of the attacker and reacts just in time to minimize the damage.

name: Double Team
effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round.
description: The Pokémon moves so fast they create a series of shadow copies of themselves. Trying to guess which one is the real one is a pain.

name: Endure
effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. If a Physical or Special Move would cause the user to faint, they remain at 1 HP instead, remove this effect afterwards. The effect re-activates on the user's next Turn. Whole Round duration.
description: The Pokémon mentally prepares to receive a fatal blow, their spirit is stronger than their body so they endure to keep on fighting for as long as possible.

name: Follow Me
effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. All Foe's Moves able to do so will Target the user. Duration 1 Round.
description: The Pokemon draws everyone’s attention, provoking their foes to do their worse.

name: Geomancy
effect: Target Self. Charge Move. Unique. Increase by 2 the User's Dexterity, Special and Sp. Defense.
description: Through a mystical conection this Pokémon absorbs the life force of earth itself to increase its power.

name: Howl
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Sound Move. Increase by 1 the Strength of those affected.
description: If you hear the howl, the pack has already surrounded you.

name: Ingrain
effect: Target Self. The User heals 1 HP at the end of each Round. Spend 1 Will point to activate. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon roots themselves to absorb nutrients directly from the ground.

name: Laser Focus
effect: Target Self. If the next Physical or Special Move the user performs gets 5 more successes required on the Accuracy Roll, ignore the Target's defenses on the Damage roll.
description: Through its incredible awarenes the Pokémon finds a straight path into a weak point of the foe. The attack that follows is devastating.

name: Meditate
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
description: Through meditation the Pokémon brings forward their mind’s strength into their body.

name: Milk Drink
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Out of battle, this Move can be used on allies.
description: The Pokémon drinks a glass of milk. Full of calcium and vitamin D it is a healthy and delicious refreshment.

name: Growth
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special. If the Sunny Weather is active, increase by 2 Instead.
description: The Pokémon makes their body grow in size. They’ll get bigger and stronger in just a few seconds.

name: Harden
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 1.
description: When life gets hard, do the same.

name: Heal Order
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
description: The queen commands the swarm to bring her healing honey.

name: King's Shield
effect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the User would receive from a Damaging Move. *If the Foe used a Non-Ranged Physical Move against the user, Reduce the foe's Strength by 2.
description: Off my chair, jester! The king sits there!

name: Lock-On
effect: Target Self. The Next Move the User Performs has 2 automatic successes added on their Accuracy Roll.
description: The Pokémon’s eyes zoom into a moving target to strike with precision at the next opportunity.

name: Magnet Rise
effect: Target Self. The User gains Immunity against Ground-Type Moves. Whole Scene Duration
description: The Pokémon creates a magnetic field to repel themselves from the ground, allowing it to float for a short period of time.

name: Miracle Eye
effect: Target Self. The User's Psychic-Type Moves ignore Dark-Type Immunity. Target cannot Evade the User's Moves. This Pokemon's Accuracy cannot be Reduced by Move's, Items or Abilities (ie Sand Attack, Bright Powder, etc.). Whole Scene Duration
description: The Pokémon opens up the third eye. Their sight trascends the barriers of flesh. No one goes undetected.

name: Minimize
effect: Target Self. The User can now make up to 5 Evasions per Round. Reduce the User's Height and Weight in half. The user is now Vulernable to: Stomp. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon compacts their body. Becoming a much smaller target to be difficult to hit. But a well placed stomp may leave them squished on the floor, though.

name: Nasty Plot
effect: Target Self. Increase User's Special by 2.
description: Rubbing both hands and laughing sinisterly the Pokémon rejoices in the evil plans they’ll soon carry out.

name: Protect
effect: Target Self. Reaction 5. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Moves that target the user.
description: A mighty energy shield materializes in front of the user to to deflect attacks and dispel ill effects.

name: Recycle
effect: Target Self. The Pokemon reuses an Item (Berries, Potions, Full Heal, etc.) that has already been spent during the battle on any side of the battlefield. Recycle can't be used more than 3 times per battle by the User.
description: One Pokémon’s trash is another one’s treasure.

name: Recover
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
description: The Pokémon uses their energy to quickly mend wounds, their regenerative powers are beyond the imagination.

name: Refresh
effect: Target Self. The User heals itself from any Burn, Freeze, Poison and Paralysis. Sleep is not healed through this effect.
description: The Pokémon takes a few seconds to cool off, refocus, and get back in the game.

name: Rock Polish
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
description: Smooth the rough edges, no need to grind about in life.

name: Shore Up
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. If performed under Sandstorm weather, this Move is a Complete Heal.
description: The Pokémon gathers the sand around themselves to restore their body to shape.

name: No Retreat
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense and Sp. Defense. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
description: No surrender. No retreat. Until victory, always!

name: Rage Powder
effect: Target Self. Reaction 2. Powder Move. All of the Foe's Physical and Special Moves will Target the user if able. Duration 1 Round.
description: The Pokémon releases an irritating powder that itches and enrages its foes into full-attack mode.

name: Quiver Dance
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Dexterity, Special an Sp. Defense.
description: A mystical and beautiful dance that increases a Pokémon focus in combat.

name: Reflect Type
effect: Target Self. Change the User's Type to match the one(s) of a foe. (ie Staryu is battle vs Charizard, their type will become Fire/Flying intead of Water) Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon is able to rewrite their own cellular composition at will to match that of potential predators. Increasing chances of survival.

name: Rest
effect: Target Self. Complete Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Put the User to Sleep.
description: Yeah, this seems like a good spot to take a nap.

name: Roost
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Remove the User's Immunity to Ground-Type Moves. Duration 1 Round.
description: The Pokémon gathers some twigs and builds themselves a comfy nest on the floor to roost and relax.

name: Run Away
effect: Target Self. The User runs away from the Battlefield. This Effect ends the Battle. Foes may try to prevent this by rolling Dexterity + Athletic and scoring the same or more Successes. If the User is Blocked, this Maneuver fails.
description: Nope. Nope. Nope.

name: Sharpen
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 1. *This effect can stack up to 3 times.
description: This Pokémon doesn’t smooth the rough edges, they make them sharper and sharper.

name: Slack Off
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
description: Some Pokémon fight by giving their maximum effort all the time, they are doing it wrong.

name: Soft Boiled
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Out of battle, this Move can be used on allies.
description: An over-easy egg for a healthy breakfast!

name: Substitute
effect: Target Self. Deal 2 damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
description: The Pokémon disappears in a poof of smoke. A decoy identical to the user takes their place in battle. The user keeps attacking from the shadows while the decoy serves as distraction.

name: Swallow
effect: Target Self. The user must have previously used the Move "Stockpile", otherwise this Move will fail. Complete Heal, if successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: After stockpiling, the Pokémon swallows the energy to restore their health, they go back to their normal size afterwards.

name: Synthesis
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will Point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal and only heals 1 HP.
description: The Pokémon gathers sunlight to re-energize themselves.

name: Ally Switch
effect: Target Self. Reaction 3. Switcher Move for the User. If successful, restore the Action this Move costed and the switched ally may use a Reaction when they enter the field.
description: The user vanishes just as they were about to be hit, and suddenly there’s another Pokémon in their place. Di-Did the user disappear? Or was it never there to begin with?

name: Aromatic Mist
effect: Target One Ally. Increase by 1 the Defense and Sp. Defense of the Target.
description: The Pokémon sprays an ally with a delicate aroma that makes everyone pull their punches against it.

name: Cover An Ally
effect: Target One Ally. Priority 1. The User will become the Target for incoming attacks towards the Target. This Cover lasts until the User's Next Turn or until the Target uses a Non-Ranged Physical Move. Pokémon with Loyalty 2 or less won't use this Maneuver.
description: Use your body as a shield to protect your friends! Not even 100 Spearrows will go through you!

name: Decorate
effect: Target One Ally. Increase by 2 the Strength and Special of the Target.
description: With just a bit of cake frosting the Pokémon decorates their target to look bigger, more powerful and incredibly delicious!

name: Shift Gear
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 1 and its Dexterity by 2.
description: Once the Pokémon shifts to the fifth gear, nothing will stop them.

name: Spiky Shield
effect: Target Self. Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokemon would receive from a Damaging Move. If the Foe used a non-ranged Physical Move. Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against it, ignore defenses.
description: The Pokémon bunkers themselves inside a shield of thorned brambles sprouting from the ground. Anyone who gets too close will get tangled in the spiky vines.

name: Stockpile
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense. Enables the use of the Moves "Spit Up" and "Swallow".
description: The Pokémon swells up like a balloon by storing power within themselves. This helps them bounce back a bit of the damage.

name: Stuff Cheeks
effect: Target Self. If the user has a held Berry, it gains its effects, afterwards, Increase User's Defense by 2. The Held berry can still be used as normal.
description: The Pokémon munches a berry but keeps half of it inside their cheeks. This looks adorable but it is actually a survival tactic to endure harsh winters.

name: Swords Dance
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Strength by 2.
description: The Pokémon dances with strong steps and a fierce attitude as a ritual to prepare for battle.

name: Tail Glow
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Special by 3.
description: The user emits a strong light. This Pokémon will stare at its own brightness to enter a trance.

name: Tail Slap
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Successive Actions.
description: The Pokémon uses their tail to repeatedly slap their foe’s face.

name: Teleport
effect: Target Self. Switcher Move for the User. Out of battle, Teleportation distances and limitations are determined by the User's Special Score and Storyteller's discretion.
description: Now you see me. Now you don’t.

name: Transform
effect: Target Self. Unique Move. The User transforms into a copy of a chosen Target. It has the same Ability, Attributes, Attribute Increases and Reductions, and Moves, keeping Transform. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon modifies their own DNA structure and becomes an identical clone to any Pokémon, creature or object it can see. Some clones keep their funny eyes.

name: Withdraw
effect: Target Self. Increase User's Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon withraw into their shell for increased protection and to avoid unwanted interactions.

name: Work Up
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Special.
description: The Pokémon has spent a lot of time training and doesn’t miss the chance to show off their muscles and fitness. After the battle they share routines and tips with the other Pokémon.

name: Fire Pledge
effect: Area Move. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: At the End of the Round, Roll 2 Dice of Fire-Type Damage to everyone without immunity to Ground on the field ignoring defenses. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of fire, their pledge is heard and the flames come forward to aid them in battle.

name: Floral Healing
effect: Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. If Performed over Grassy Terrain this move is a Complete Heal.
description: The user creates a flower crown that heals and relaxes its wearer. Under the right conditions this move also creates a flower patch around its target.

name: Gear Up
effect: Target One Ally. Increase by 1 the Strength and Spcial of one Steel-Type of Electric-Type Ally.
description: The Pokémon performs a basic manteniance on their ally. A change of oil and filters, new spark plugs, and the ally is more than ready!

name: Grass Pledge
effect: Area Move. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those affected. This Effect Targets the Battle Field: Entry Hazard. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of Target's that enter the battlefield. Pokemon with Immunity to Ground are not affected.
description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of grass, their pledge is heard and the ground crumbles as vegetation grapples and traps everyone in the field.

name: Heal Pulse
effect: Target One Ally. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate.
description: Commanding the mind over the matter, the Pokémon speeds up the healing process on an ally.

name: Help Another
effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. Roll your Accuracy as if it were Chance dice. Add 1 die to the Accuracy Roll of your Ally for each Success (result of 6) obtained this way. Up to 3 Characters may attempt to help a single Action. Up to 6 Dice may be added this way.
description: Not being the best suited for a task doesn’t mean you won’t do your part in helping out. The best teams work together!

name: Helping Hand
effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 5. The Target Gets 2 Extra Dice on their next Skill Check/Accuracy Roll, and 2 Extra Dice on their next Damage Roll. This Effect does not Stack.
description: The Pokémon is the first to come and give a hand to their friend. A true bro.

name: Lunar Dance
effect: Target Self. Unique. Roll the User's Remaining HP as Typeless Damage dice to itself. One allied Target restores its full HP and it is cured from any Status Condition, if it was fainted, restore conciousness. If the chosen Target is not in-battle, it is called out and ready to fight with the same remaining actions as the user.
description: The moon shines at the darkest hours, reflecting sun’s life bringer light on those fallen into the night. Cresselia takes pity of their lost souls and guides them towards the dawn.

name: Spotlight
effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 3. All of the Foe's Moves will Target the Chosen Ally if able. Duration 1 Round.
description: The user points a focused light onto one of their allies. The ally can’t help but catch everyone’s attention into itself.

name: Stabilize An Ally
effect: The User applies CPR and/or first aid to an unconcious Ally. Target won't receive Lethal Damage each hour anymore. Each Lethal Damage on the Ally reduces 1 Success to the Accuracy Pool of this Maneuver. This Move may only be attempted on the Target once per hour.
description: Apply pressure! Give chest compressions! Suck out the venom! You are not losing anyone today!

name: Water Pledge
effect: Area Move. This Effect Targets the Battlefield: Add 2 Dice to all Chance Dice rolls of everyone in the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The Pokémon chants to invoke the power of water. Moisture in the air bends the light to create a rainbow to bring good fortune. Everyone in the field feels luckier for a while.

name: Acid Downpour
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Ambush
effect: Single Target. Before the Battle starts, Target may resist by rolling: Insight + Alert and scoring the same or more Successes. The User has 1 Action before Initiatives are rolled in which the Target can't act. Other foes can still Evade or Clash during this time.
description: Sneak through the shadows, stay low to the ground, and prepare yourself to pounce on an unsuspecting foe.

name: All-Out Pummeling
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Remove Barriers, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Alluring Voice
effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Confuse the Target.
description: Since ancient times, sailors have warned against the siren’s alluring voice calling out for you in the middle of the sea. Now you know why.

name: Aqua Cutter
effect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical. Cutter Move.
description: The User compacts water and shoots it as a pressurized jet. This jet is very sharp and can easily cut through solids.

name: Aqua Step
effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
description: The most fluid dance steps you’ll ever see. The user toys with their target by kicking and splashing around.

name: Armor Cannon
effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The user shoots a mighty blast by using its own armor out as blazing projectiles.

name: Astral Barrage
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. Unique.
description: Call upon the restless spirits of the dead and send them to destroy your opponents. A truly frightening sight to witness.

name: Axe Kick
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 4 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
description: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target leaving it both allured and scared. The heel may break if the kick fails.

name: Barb Barrage
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target. *If the Target already has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

name: Bitter Blade
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
description: The user focuses its bitter feelings towards the world of the living into a slashing attack, seeing the suffering it brings to others makes it feel reinvigorated.

name: Bitter Malice
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Freeze the Foe. *If the Target already has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
description: The victim is hit by an onslaught of evil energy. Filled with dread, the victim is unable to move.

name: Blazing Torque
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance dice to inflict 2nd Degee Burn on the Target.
description: The user is spun into a fiery torque with live flames on it!

name: Bleakwind Storm
effect: Area Move. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Freeze those affected.
description: A furious storm ravages the battlefield, cold winds swirl in such a menacing way that you don’t know if the chill comes from the ice or the sheer terror invading you.

name: Blood Moon
effect: Single Target. If this Move was used on the previous Round, it fails (Clashing counts as using the Move.)
description: The Blood Moon rises once again. When the glow of the bloodstained moon shines upon the land, the aimless spirits of slain monsters return to flesh. The world is threatened once again.

name: Black Hole Eclipse
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Bloom Doom
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Heal 1 HP, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Breakneck Blitz
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Chloroblast
effect: Single Target. Recoil.
description: The Pokémon concentrates all of the chlorophyll inside of their body to make it explode. Targets are tinted green for days afterwards.

name: Dire Claw
effect: Single Target. High Critical. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Poison the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to put the Target to Sleep.
description: The Pokémon makes a cut on their victim with claws drenched in venom; then patiently stalks it, waiting for the toxins to wear it out.

name: Dual Wingbeat
effect: Single Target. Low Accuarcy 1. Double action.
description: The Pokémon slams the foe from above. Each wing provides a good smacking.

name: Grassy Glide
effect: Single Target. *If Grassy Terrain is active, this Move has Reaction 1.
description: A single leaf can hold the entire weight of the Pokémon. When moving, it appears to glide over the grass.

name: Inferno Overdrive
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Kowtow Cleave
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. Never Miss.
description: The user gets on their knees and bows to its foe, then as the foe accepts this courtesy, a treacherous slash reveals the evil intent of the ruse.

name: Max Darkness
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Special of those Affected.

name: Max Mindstorm
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Psychic Terrain. Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Steelspike
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase the Defense of the User and Allies in Range by 1.

name: Order Up
effect: Single Target. Unique. If the User is giving cover to a #978 Tatsugiri Ally. Increase by 1 an Attribute depending on the Ally's color. *Orange - Strength *Red - Defense *Yellow - Dexterity
description: The user waits for orders and adheres to the strategy of a smaller but smarter ally.

name: Rage Fist
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move for every time the User has received Damage this Round, up to 8 Dice may be added this way.
description: The Pokémon focuses all of their rage into a single fist, the more they suffered the more dark energy will concentrate.

name: Scorching Sands
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the foe.
description: The sand around the user heats to scorching temperatures as it is thrown against their foe.

name: Syrup Bomb
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Projectile Move. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1. *This effect can stack up to 3 Times.
description: The Pokémon spits out a red syrup on their foe; as the syrup hardens the movement of the foe becomes impaired until they become a sweet caramelized statue.

name: Tera Blast
effect: Single Target. *If the User is actively Terastallized, the Type of this Move changes to match that of the Tera-Type. This affects Weaknesses, Resistances and STAB accordingly.
description: A blast of sharp crystals and Tera energy, if the Pokémon is Terastallized the energy’s type will change. It is something beautiful to witness.

name: Thunderous Kick
effect: Single Target. Reduce Target's Defense by 1.
description: The user splits open the field with a single lightning-fast kick. Even bystanders are sent flying away by the powerful shockwave.

name: Victory Dance
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense. Add 1 Die to the User's Damage Pool for all Non-Ranged Physical Attacks.
description: The user dances spelling the letters “EZ” in a display of overconfidence. Encouraging their foes to either get good or give up already

name: Burning Bulwark
effect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the User would receive from a Damaging Move. *If the Foe used a Non-Ranged Physical Move, inflicct 1st Degree Burn to it.
description: The Pokémon lights a fire coat around itself as a protective barrier. It is not a good idea to touch it.

name: Burning Jealousy
effect: Target All Foes in Range. *Inflict 1st Degree Burn on all affected Targets with Increased Attributes.
description: The user can’t stand the idea that others are better than them. Their jealousy manifests in the form of a fiery aura that sticks to those the user despises de most.

name: Coaching
effect: Target All Allies in Range. Increase by 1 the Strength and Defense of all Allies targeted. The User cannot target itself.
description: This Pokémon allies form a line and start doing squats and push-ups while the user corrects their form and gives them tips and a confidence boost to win this match.

name: Combat Torque
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance dice to Paralyze the Target.
description: After shaking and beating their target up, the user will attempt to immovilize them.

name: Double Shock
effect: Single Target. Lethal. After damage is dealt, the user loses its Electric-Type. If its only type was Electric, it is now Typeless. User's Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves have Power 0. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the User.
description: The user lets out a colossal discharge of electricity, lightning connecting the sky and earth for way too long. However, the effort effectively depletes the energy reserves of the user.

name: Dragon Cheer
effect: Target Allies in Range. All Physical and Special Moves of the Allies now have the "High Critical" Added Effect. *If an Ally is a Dragon-Type, Increase their Strength and Special by 1.
description: With a mighty roar, the Pokémon fires up the battle spirit of their companions on their quest for victory.

name: Expanding Force
effect: Single Target. Lethal. *If Psychic Terrain is active, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move and you may add another target to it.
description: Psychic energies form a bubble of light to damage the foe. Under Psychic Terrain, the energy is so big it turns into a tall pillar that crushes anyone inside.

name: Glacial Lance
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. Unique.
description: It looks just like any other Blizzard until the ice spears start raining straight into you.

name: Headlong Rush
effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: This Pokémon is headstrong in a very very literal way.

name: Hydro Vortex
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Judgement
effect: Single Target. Unique. Ignore Defenses. This Move's Type, Power and extra Added Effects are decided by Storyteller. If something would prevent this Move from dealing Damage, ignore it. This Move can't be Clashed.
description: Sooner or later, everyone gets what they deserve.

name: Jet Punch
effect: Single Target. Reaction 1. Fist Move.
description: The fist of justice strikes true, swift...and wet!

name: Lunar Blessing
effect: *Target User or Target one Ally. Unique. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Complete Heal. Heal all status Ailments on the Target. Reduce 1 success to all Accuracy Rolls of one foe.
description: Put your faith on the moon, pray during dark times and it shall bring light into your heart, guide the strayed, and cast away the creatures from the shadows.

name: Malignant Chain
effect: Single Target. Unique. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Badly Poison the Target. At the end of the Round, if the Target was Poisoned by this Move, roll their Loyalty, get at least 3 successes, if it fails, from the next Round the Target becomes the user's Ally untl the poison is healed.
description: This chain contains the most potent neurotoxin currently known. It boosts physical appearance, yet totally suppresses the mind and soul, turning the target into the user’s puppet.

name: Max Guard
effect: Target Max Self. Shield Move. Reaction 5. Reduce 5 Damage this Max Pokemon would receive from a Physical or Special Move. Negate the Added Effects of Any Move that targets the Max User

name: Max Hailstorm
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Hail Weather. (Disregard location) Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Chilling Water
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Strength by 1.
description: The Pokémon douses cold water in the head of their foe in order to make them think straight. Surprisingly, it works.

name: Cloroblast
effect: Single Target. Recoil.
description: The Pokémon concentrates all of the chlorophyll inside of their body to make it explode. Targets are tinted green for days afterwards.

name: Corrosive Gas
effect: Area Attack. Those affected lose their held item.
description: The Pokémon releases a powerful acidic gas that melts all inorganic matter in seconds.

name: Esper Wing
effect: Single Target. High Critical. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
