description: The User slashes the foe with psychic energy channeled through their wings. This energy also allows it to cut through the air and fly faster.

name: Gigavolt Havoc
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Paralyze, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Ice Spinner
effect: Single Target. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.
description: The user covers their feet with sharp ice blades and skates through the field making gracious spins to hit the target. The battlefield ends up cut by the blades though.

name: Lumina Crash
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Foe's Sp. Defense by 2.
description: The user flashes a light pattern that crashes the foe’s mind, leaving it acting erraticaly for a few moments.

name: Max Knuckle
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase he Strength of Userand Allies in Range by 1.

name: Psyshield Bash
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The user cloaks itself in a shield of psychic energy then rams into the foe.

name: Ruination
effect: Single Target. Unique. Lethal. Roll Damage dice equal to the Target's Total HP. Ignore Defenses. This move will fail if the Target has been previously hit with this Move during the Battle.
description: The Pokémon summons a disaster to befall onto their victim, few make it out alive, and those who do don’t stay that way for long.

name: Shell Side Arm
effect: Single Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Poison the Target. *If the User's Strength score is higher than their Special, this Move becomes Physical, using Brawl for accuracy and inflicting damage with Strength.
description: The Pokémon shoots slime ammunition from their cannon-like arm, or strike the foe directly with the cannon arm. They may find themselves out of ammo, but never out of options.

name: Spin Out
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce the User's Dexterity by 2.
description: The Pokémon spins against the target, with it pinned on the ground. This devastating Move leaves the Pokémon too tired to spin a lot more.

name: Thunder Cage
effect: Single Target. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
description: Several lightning spheres are placed in the battlefied as if they were a tesla coil. Shooting thunderbolts non-stop and blasting those unfortunate enough to be trapped in it.

name: Upper Hand
effect: Single Target. Reaction 3. *If this Move is used as a Reaction to another Reaction, Flinch the Target.
description: The battle is over when you’ve got the high ground, but the foe refuses to acknowledge it.

name: Wicked Torque
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Ranged. Roll 1 Chance die to put th Target to Sleep.
description: The user torques out their victim at a high speed with such force they may simply drop unconscious.

name: Acid Armor
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
description: Highly acidic goop oozes through the pores of this Pokémon. Touching it immediately causes a burning pain. Preventing foes from getting too close.

name: Apple Acid
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Foe's Sp. Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon produces a sap from the tart apples they feed on, if the apples are not ripe their sap will be acidic and bad for teeth.

name: Ceaseless Edge
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. High Critical. Cutter Move. Ongoing Damage with Duration of 4 Rounds.
description: The user slashes the foe using a sharp but brittle shell. Tiny spikes from the shell are left embeded into the foe’s wounds causing more damage as the foe moves.

name: Continental Crush
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Remove Terrain, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Curse (Non-Ghost)
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength and Defense. Reduce by 1 the User's Dexterity. This effect only works if the User is not Ghost-Type.

name: Fickle Beam
effect: Single Target Before you roll damage, Roll 1 die to determine this Move's Power.
description: The Pokémon is formed by many individual heads who rarely agree with one another, but when they do their combined power is devastating.

name: Flip Turn
effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for the User.
description: Charge at the foe as a cannon ball made out of water. The big splash causes bystanders to lose sight on the battlefield. When the splash settles, the user is gone.

name: Glaive Rush
effect: Single Target. Lethal. The User is now Vulnerable to: The Next Physical or Special Move that targets them.
description: The user attacks with its sharp dorsal fin by doing a somersault slash. This can pretty much slice in half anything, but it also leaves the user prone to sneak attacks.

name: Hyper Drill
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Ignore Shield Moves active on the Foe or their side of the field.
description: Using their tail as a powerful drill, the Pokémon pierces through any surface it comes in contact with.

name: Max Geyser
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Rain Weather. (Disregard location) Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Overgrowth
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Grassy Terrain. Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Wyrmwind
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Strength of those Affected.

name: Mighty Cleave
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Ignore Shield Moves & Force Fields active on the foe or their side of the field.
description: With a mighty light, the Pokémon cleaves through the foe’s protections and strikes like a boulder.

name: Mortal Spin
effect: All Foes in Range. Poison those Affected. Remove Entry Hazards, Terrains (ie Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain), Ongoing Damage and Leech seed from the User or their side of the field.
description: The user spins around the field, cutting through obstacles and shooting small darts full of a toxic venom. The earth is now poisoned and left barren.

name: Population Bomb
effect: Single Target. Unique. Low Accuracy 2. Successive Actions.
description: The Pokémon and their family attack the foe in waves. Parents, children, cousins, aunts, uncles, and extended relatives, the whole family tree will appear on an onslaught.

name: Scale Shot
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Ranged. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, Increase the User's Dexterity by 1, and lower the User's Defense by 1.
description: The Pokémon’s scales burst out as if they were shrapnel from a grenade.

name: Skitter Smack
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Special by 1.
description: The Pokémon stalks and strikes the foe, usually from behind bushes or any sort of cover.

name: Steel Roller
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Can't be used if there is no Active Terrain (Grassy Terrain, Electric Terrain, etc.) on the Battlefield. Remove any active Terrain on the Battlefield.
description: The Pokémon rolls into a wheel, destroying anything in their path. Buildings come crashing down, forests are swept away and the soil is left as a blank slate.

name: Supercell Slam
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. If the Accuracy roll fails, Roll 4 Dice of Typeless Damage against the user, ignoring defenses.
description: The user charges itself, jumps up high, then free-falls to crash on the target at a high speed. Beware of not ending up crashing directly against the floor.

name: Chilly Reception
effect: Target Battlefield. Switcher Move For the User. Activate Snowy Weather. Duration 4 Rounds. Pokemon with this Move may forfeit their Cool score completely. If the Pokemon forgets this Move, restore 1 Point to their Cool Score.
description: “What did a Geodude say to another Geodude? Let’s Rock!” The User tells a joke so terrible the whole battlefield freezes. Afterwards, the user retreats in shame.

name: Corkscrew Crash
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Ignore Ability, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Devastating Drake
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Sound Move, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Dragon Energy
effect: Target All foes in Range. Lethal. *Reduce 1 Dice from the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 dice may be removed this way.
description: The Pokémon converts its life-energy into a life-ending beam. No exaggeration.

name: Fiery Wrath
effect: Target all Foes in Range. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch those affected.
description: The Pokémon’s wrath is turned to flames that consume the foe’s body and soul.

name: Flower Trick
effect: Single Target. Never Miss. This Move is always considered to be a Critical Hit and gets the proper Bonus for it.
description: The user throws a bouquet of flowers at the target, who holds them close believing them to be a gift, only to realize the bouquet were flower bombs.

name: Gigaton Hammer
effect: Single Target. Lethal. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round. *This Move may deal 2 Extra Damage Dice to Steel-Type Pokemon at Storyteller's Discretion.
description: When you have a hammer everything is a nail.

name: Infernal Parade
effect: Single Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the Foe. *If the Target has an active Status Condition, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
description: 'You may not be the type to faint when things are odd or things are quaint. But seeing flames you know that ain’t will scorch you into dismay't will scorch you into dismay.'

name: Matcha Gotcha
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Projectile Move. Low Accuracy 1. The User restores hp equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. If the user is Frozen solid, destroy the ice block.
description: The user invites the foe to a hebal tea ceremony. As the tea is served and the foe is off guard, the user throws the hot tea on them, then proceeds to enjoy their own cup.

name: Max Rockfall
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Sandstorm Weather. (Disregard location Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Revival Blessing
effect: Target One Ally. The User must spend all of their remaining Will points, if the user has no remaining Will points, this Move fails. Restore conciousness and 2 HP to a fainted ally. If no Ally is fainted this Move fails. The ally does not need to be active in combat.
description: The Pokémon prays to the skies with such selfless fervor and devotion that a miracle is granted.

name: Savage Spin-Out
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Blocked, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Triple Arrows
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Triple Action. Reduce the foe's Defense by 1. *If All 3 hits land, all of the User's Physical and Special Moves now have the "High Critical" Effect, this effect has a whole scene duration.
description: Three fast arrows shot in succession. The Pokémon who manages to land all three in the exact same spot has become a true sniper.

name: Wave Crash
effect: Single Target. Recoil. Reduce User's Dexterity by 1.
description: The Pokémon rides a tsunami-like wave an slams it against its target. The crash is very destructive and the Pokémon may end up falling from the ride.

name: After You
effect: Target One Ally. Reaction 1. The Target will go First in the Initiative Order. If used again, the previous target reverts to their original Initiative order. Whole Scene Duration.
description: The user bows and courteously lets a friend go first.

name: Attract
effect: Single Target. Target is now In Love with the User.
description: Through their good looks and coquetish attitude, the Pokémon makes everyone develop a crush on them.

name: Clash
effect: Target Self. Reaction 6. Match the number of successes on the Accuracy roll of a Move that targets the User. If successful, the user Clashes, see p.68. This Maneuver is not affected by the Multiple Action difficulty chart.
description: A power struggle can become a clash of mights, usually with explosive results.

name: Contrict
effect: Single Target. This Move deals Typeless Damage. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.

name: Doodle
effect: Single Target. Replace the User's Ability with the Target's. Whole Scene Duration. Unique Abilities can't be copied.
description: By doodling a quick drawing of their target the doodle somehow allows the Pokémon to make use of the depicted creature’s powers.

name: Eerie Spell
effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Target spends 3 Will points without any benefit, this effect does not stack.
description: The Pokémon mutters ancient spell, forbidden words break the spirit to make the victim easier to manipulate.

name: Evasion
effect: Target Self. Reaction 6. Match the number of successes on the Accuracy roll of a Move that targets the User. If successful, the user Evades, see p.68. This Maneuver is not affected by the Multiple Action difficulty chart.
description: No time to think! If you hear "Dooooooodge!" You get out of the way A.S.A.P

name: Hard Press
effect: Single Target. *Reduce 1 Die from the Damage Pool for every missing Hp the User has. Up to 5 Dice may be removed this way.
description: The foe is grappled in a painful lock, the more it struggles to get out the more pressure it’s gonna feel. The user must be on top condition for this grapple to be effective.

name: Last Respects
effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move for every ally that Fainted during this Battle Up to 8 Dice may be added this way.
description: The Pokémon gathers the souls the departed and helps them fulfill their desire of revenge before moving on.

name: Make It Rain
effect: Area Move. Reduce the User's Special by 2. At the end of the battle give the User and every Trainer whose Pokemon was hit, Money equal to their Rank: Starter/Rookie - 100 Standard - 250 Advanced - 500 Ace or more - 1000
description: The Pokémon calls a rain of gold to fall from the sky. All the greedy Pokémon who threw themselves at the money get in range for an explosion of golden light. Worth it!

name: Max Flutterby
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Special of those Affected.

name: Misty Explosion
effect: Area Attack. Lethal. The User faints after using this Move. *If Misty Terrain is active, add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
description: The user razes the field with a searing nuke of made of love, joy, kisses, and pink glitter. It is deadly.

name: Psyblade
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Cutter Move. *If Electric Terrain is active, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move.
description: The Pokémon attacks using an ethereal blade. Electric energy will increase the sharpness of its edge.

name: Salt Cure
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Steel-Type and Water-Type Pokemon receive Super-Effective Damage from this Move and 1 Extra Damage from the Ongoing Damage.
description: The user covers the foe with a salt crust, the salt irritates the skin and drehydrates the victim. It can even rust metal in a few seconds.

name: Shattered Psyche
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Activate Psychic Terrain, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Springtide Storm
effect: Area Move. Lethal. Low Accuracy 2. *Choose one: Roll 3 Chance Dice to increase by 1 the User's Strength, Special, Dexterity, Defense & Sp. Defense. Or, Roll 3 Chance dice to Reduce by 2 the affected Defense & Sp. Defense.
description: The whole battlefield becomes engulfed in a maelstrom of emotion. Love and hate deal emotional damage to those unfortunate enough to be trapped into it.

name: Take Heart
effect: Target Self. Heal any Status Ailment on the User. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
description: There’s something only you can do so that this blue planet doesn’t lose it’s light. Believe in yourself and show your brave heart.

name: Trailblaze
effect: Single Target. Increase the User's Dexterity by 1.
description: With their nimble footwork. the user leaps out of the tall grass to take the foe by surprise.

name: Collision Course
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. *Add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target is weak to Fight-Type Moves.
description: Koraidon dashes through the field with a screeching sound, it will not stop until it violently crashes. Causing a massive prehistoric explosion.

name: Electro Shot
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Charge Move. If Rain Weather is active, you skip this Move's Charge acton. Increase the User's Special Score by 1.
description: The user stands as tall as possible, waiting for a lightning to strike. Then re-directs the lightning directly towards the foe; recharging themselves in the process.

name: Freezing Glare
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze the Target.
description: The Pokémon shoots freakin’ laser beams from its freakin’ eyes against everything that moves...until nothing does.

name: Hydro Steam
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target. *If Sunny Weather is active, this Move does not reduce damage due to it, and has 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move.
description: When water and fire work together you’ll wish they didn’t set aside their differences.

name: Ivy Cudgel
effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Secondary Type if possible Otherwise their Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances, and STAB accordingly.
description: The Pokémon creates a club out of thorny ivy vines, this club is infused with the power of nature, everchanging.

name: Max Flare
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Sunny Weather (Disregard time of day or location) Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Ooze
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase the Special of User and Allies in Range by 1.

name: Max Strike
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those Affected.

name: Meteor Beam
effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Increase the User's Special by 1 the moment it begins charging.
description: The user overflows with galactic energy while summoning a small meteor to impact the foe. A theory suggests this move might have caused the extintion of prehistoric Pokémon.

name: Sandsear Storm
effect: Area Move. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict 2nd Degree Burn on those affected.
description: An overwhelming storm made of blistering sands rages through the battlefield, survivors describe it as being hit with live coal embers.

name: Spicy Extract
effect: Single Target. Increase the Target's Strength by 2. Reduce the Target's Defense by 2.
description: The user dares their victim to eat a hot pepper, out of pride, the foe does and suffers as the pepper was double-loaded with spicy extract.

name: Tachyon Cutter
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Lethal. Never Miss. Double Action.
description: The Pokémon swings with a sword so sharp, it cuts twice.

name: Triple Axel
effect: Single Target. Triple Action. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage of the 2nd hit and 2 Extra Dice to the Damage of the 3rd hit. **Second hit has Low Accuracy 1. ***Third hit has Low Accuracy 2.
description: A series of cold-blooded kicks that break bone as they would break brittle ice.

name: Wildbolt Storm
effect: Area Move. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
description: The whole battlefield becomes engulfed in a wild lightning storm. Leaving the safety of cover could be a fatal mistake.

name: Agility
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Dexterity by 2.
description: Swift of body, swift of mind.

name: Acupressure
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 one of the User's Attributes or Traits at Random (Strength, Dexterity, Special, Defense, Sp. Defense, Accuracy, Evasion). If this Move is used again, the previous Attribute increase is removed.
description: The user begins pushing pressure points on their body to unlock a hidden potential they didn’t even knew they had.

name: Psybeam
effect: Single Target. Roll 1 Chance Die to Confuse the Target.
description: The foe’s mind isassaulted by a mental ray, afterwards they may suffer from hallucinations.

name: Comeuppance
effect: Single Target. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical or Special Move. Roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice.
description: An eye for en eye, the user retaliates with a vengance against those who cross them.

name: Electro Drift
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. *Add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move if the Target is weak to Electric-Type Moves.
description: Miraidon accelerates its turbines and races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target in a blast of futuristic electricity

name: Fillet Away
effect: Target Self. Deal 2 Damage to the User. Increase the User's Strength, Dexterity and Special by 2.
description: The Pokémon slices pieces of itself to sharpen out the edges and give themselves a more hydrodynamic shape.

name: Hold Hands
effect: Single Target. The battle may end at the Storyteller's discretion. Target may resist rolling their Will Score against the Accuracy of this Move. Out of battle, aid to reduce hostile intent.
description: The user offers their hand in friendship, if the other Pokémon holds their hand they’ll be very happy and become good friends.

name: Lash Out
effect: Single Target. *Add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move if any of the user's Attributes/Traits was lowered this Round.
description: The user fulminates the foe with the power of its frustration and a shriek of despair.

name: Max Airstream
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase the Dexterity of User and Allies in Range by 1.

name: Max Lightning
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Electric Terrain. Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Max Starfall
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Activate the Effects of Misty Terrain. Duration 4 Rounds.

name: Never-Ending Nightmare
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Ignore Ability, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Shelter
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense. Reduce 1 success to all the Accuracy Rolls of the Foes when targeting the User.
description: The user uses a sturdy part of their body as a shelter to hide. It’s difficult for the foes to find an opening.

name: Snowscape
effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Snowy Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: A heavy snowstorm sweeps through the battlefield, covering everything with a thick layer of snow.

name: Stone Axe
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. High Critical. Cutter Move. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The Pokémon hacks at the foe with a furious stone axe. Pointy pebbles and rubble remain within the cut, making the foe start limping.

name: Subzero Slammer
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Roll 3 Chance Dice to inflict Frozen, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Terrain Pulse
effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool if there is a Terrain active in the Battlefield. Change this Move's Type to match that of a currently active Terrain (ie Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, etc.).
description: The user shoots a pulse that absorbs the energy flowing in the area to devastate its foes.

name: Thunderclap
effect: Single Target. Reaction 6. *This Move can only be used as a Reaction and only if the Target used a Physical or Special Move, otherwise it will fail.
description: The Pokémon summons lightning from the sky. A foe gathering energy makes for the perfect rod for lightning to be attracted to it.

name: Acrobatics
effect: Single Target. *If the User has a Held Item, Reduce 2 Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
description: The Pokémon is quick and graceful, they cartwheel, contort and make a double back jump before landing onthe foe. Their best perfomance is done when they are unburdened.

name: Jungle Healing
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Heal any Status Ailment (Burn, Freeze, Paralysis, Poison & Sleep) on the Targets. Restore 1 HP to the targets. If successful spend 1 Will point to activate.
description: A stream of life force from plants and trees flow into the User and their Allies.

name: Magical Torque
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance dice to Confuse the Target.
description: With the flick of a wand the user is spun around in a magic swirl that leaves them absolutely dizzy.

name: Max Phantasm
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Reduce by 1 the Defense of those Affected.

name: Max Quake
effect: Target all foes in Range or a Single Max Target. Increase the Sp. Defense of the User and Allies in Range by 1.

name: Mystical Power
effect: Target Self. Increase by 2 the User's lowest Attribute/Trait. If an Attribute/Trait Score is 6 or More, this effect fails. Different Attributes/Traits may be increased this way.
description: The power is inside you. You can feel it in your heart, you can see it in your mind. Believe in yourself and take it!

name: Pounce
effect: Single Target. Reduce the Target's Dexterity by 1.
description: The Pokémon stands very still, and just as their foe approaches, they suddenly launch into attacking.

name: Raging Fury
effect: Target Random foe. Ranged. Rampage.
description: The Pokémon goes mad with rage, spitting fire viciously all over the battlfield and barely recognizing friend from foe.

name: Silk Trap
effect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the User would receive from a Damaging Move. *If the Foe used a Non-Ranged Physical Move, against the user Reduce the foe's Dexterity by 2.
description: The Pokémon weaves a thread of silk around specific parts of their body, both as an armor and as a trap to snare their enemies.

name: Supersonic Skystrike
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Attribute Decrease, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Triple Dive
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Triple Action.
description: The user performs a triple dive jump with perfect timing. The foe is washed away by each water splash.

name: Assist
effect: Target One Ally. Copy Move. Choose one Move known by an Ally or member of your party, who may or may not be active in battle. You may choose another Target(s) for the Move. Unique Moves can't be copied.
description: The user hurriedly remembers actions performed by others and mimics them. Some Pokémon can even imitate human tasks and help carry them out.

name: Baddy Bad
effect: Single Target. After dealing damage, activate a Force Field against Physical Damage with a Duration of 4 Rounds on the User's side of the Field. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: The Pokémon acts like a thug and channels its own dark aura as protection for itself and its allies.

name: Block
effect: Single Target. Blocks. Whole Scene Duration.
description: You don’t seem to understand. I’m not blocked in here with you... You are blocked in here with me!

name: Double Iron Bash
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Unique. Double Action. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe after each hit. This Move may only Flinch once.
description: The user hardens its limbs and then rotates them at great speed to hit the foe twice in a row. The blow can leave the victim crushed on the floor.

name: Disarming Voice
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move. Never Miss.
description: With a charming but manipulative cry, the user deals emotional damage to their opponent by making them feel guilty.

name: Fell Stinger
effect: Single Target. *If used against a fainted Target ot if the Target faints due to damage from this Move, Increase the User’s Strength by 2.
description: The Pokémon stings the target, if the foe is too weakened to move, the user absorbs their power.

name: Mountain Gale
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.

name: Psychic Noise
effect: Single Target. Target can't restore HP. Duration 2 Rounds.
description: The target gets a migraine so awful it can only hear white noise inside of its head.

name: Rising Voltage
effect: Single Target. Lethal. *If Electric Terrain is active, add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move.
description: A shockwave travels through the ground, then rises as a golden pillar of thunderbolts.

name: Tera Starstorm
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Unique Move. *If the User is actively Terastallized, the Type of this Move changes to match that of the Tera-Type, this affects Weaknesses, Resistances and STAB accordingly. Change the type of those affected at random.
description: Tera crystals full of energy fall from the sky as meteors. A beautiful but extemely chaotic scene follows as all Pokémon absorb the Tera Energy without control.

name: Tidy Up
effect: Target Battlefield. Remove all active Substitute/Shed Tail Decoys and Entry Hazards (ie Sticky Web, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, etc.). Increase the User's Strength and Dexterity by 1.
description: The user coordinates a quick and efficient way to clean up the whole place. No things scattered on the floor, no toys out of the toybox. Perfect for when visits come over.

name: Twin Beam
effect: Single Target. Double Action.
description: The Pokémon shoots a beam, and as if had a mind of its own, another part of their body also shoots a beam along.

name: Absorb
effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down.
description: The user takes nutrients from the nearest source of life they find.

name: Beak Blast
effect: Single Target. Charge Move. Ranged. Projectile Move. *If the User is hit by a Non-Ranged Physical Move while this Move is charging, inflict 2nd Degree Burn on the attacker.
description: The Pokémon gets ready to release a boiling gas through its beak, which gets incredibly hot. The resulting blast sounds like a train’s horn.

name: Bite
effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe
description: The user lands a vicious bite, leaving an ugly bruise.

name: Feint
effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 1. This Move ignores the effects of any Shield Move active on the Target and removes their effects for the rest of the Round.
description: The user begins their attack, and as their target attempts to protect itself, the user feints the target to break their defense against their true strike.

name: Guillotine
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 5. Deal Damage equal to the Target's Remaining HP, plus 1 Lethal Damage.
description: Fueled by the spirit of revolution the Pokémon sentences their foe to be reduced at the neck. This devastating attack requires an emergency trip to the Pokémon Center...and a basket.

name: Iron Defense
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
description: Iron body, iron will. This Pokémon is unbreakable.

name: Moonblast
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Reduce Target's Special by 1.
description: The user becomes a champion of lunar justice. In the name of the moon, they will right the wrongs and triumph over evil!

name: Morning Sun
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. If Sunny Weather is in effect, this Move becomes a Complete Heal. If performed under Rain, Sandstorm, Hail or Snowy Weather, this Move is a Minor heal only heals 1 HP.
description: The Pokémon feels revitalized with the bright sun early in the mornings.

name: Noxious Torque
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
description: Surrounded by noxious gases, the victim is spun around at high speeds.

name: Power Shift
effect: Target Self. Switch the User's Strength with its Defense and its Special with its Sp. Defense.
description: The Pokémon knows that sometimes the best defense is a good offense.

name: Raging Bull
effect: Single Target. *The Type of this Move becomes the same as the User's Secondary Type if possible, otherwise their Main Type. This affects Weakness, Resistances and STAB accordingly.
description: The Pokémon charges against a foe, trampling through with a righteous fury, a blazing rage, a cold wrath, or maybe just the senseless desire for violence.

name: Shed Tail
effect: Target Self. Switcher Move for the User. Deal 2 Damage to the User. Put a Substitute Decoy with 2 HP and the same defenses as the user. See p. 531
description: The Pokémon sheds their tail and leaves it as a decoy while it retreats to safety and lets someone else deal with the threat.

name: Struggle
effect: Single Target.
description: Scuffle about and make every effort to deliver a blow.

name: Surging Strikes
effect: Single Target. Successive Actions. Unique. This Move is always considered Critical Hit and gets the proper bonus for it.
description: The ultimate technique from the swift “Water Style”. The User flows and smashes like waves striking a cliff.

name: Temper Flare
effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move is the User failed the Accuracy roll of the last Move it performed.
description: The Pokémon is a hot-head whose temper grows ever fiercer when dealing with frustration.

name: Torch Song
effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Increase the User's Special by 1.
description: Through a sweet melody the foe burns a haunting memory into those who harbor ill intent.

name: Aeroblast
effect: Single Target. Wind Move. Lethal. High Critical. Unique.
description: The victim is trapped in a violently swirling vortex. The strong wind currents make debris fly everywhere.

name: Barrier
effect: Target Self. Increase the User's Defense by 2.
description: Whenever a foe attempts to to get too close to the user, they suddenly stop as if something ...or someone, prevented their movement.

name: Curse
effect: Single Target. Roll half of the User's HP as Typeless Damage Dice to itself, ignoring defenses. The Target will remove 1 success from all of their Rolls until the Curse if lifted.
description: The user mutters an evil incantation, misery will befall into the foe at the cost of the user’s soul. To get rid of the curse, perform an exorcism or get help at a Pokémon Center

name: Fling
effect: Single Target. Ranged. *If the User is holding an Item, Add up to 4 dice to the damage pool. User loses its Held Item. See p. 530
description: The Pokémon takes their held item, uses it as a weapon and the referee is somehow OK with this. The held item remains in the field and may be recovered after the battle.

name: Fleur Cannon
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Unique. Reduce User's Special by 2.
description: A light beam pierces the battlefield, it deals devastating damage but leaves newly grown flowers instead of scorched earth. The user is left feeling very tired.

name: Heart Swap
effect: Single Target. Switch the User's Trait and Attribute Increases and Reductions with those on the Target's.
description: The User enters the mind of the foe to give implant them with their own feelings of insecurity and take the foe’s feelings of confidence in itself.

name: Poison Fang
effect: Single Target. Bite Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Badly Poison the Target.
description: The Pokémon goes for a quick bite, releasing the foe just as fast. Let the poison slowly consume the foe from the inside out. No need to spend more energy when a drop is more than enough.

name: Tectonic Rage
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: Attribute Decrease, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Twinkle Tackle
effect: Single Target. Suggested effects: In Love, Attribute Increase, Damage Increase See p. 610 for more info.

name: Attack Order
effect: Single Target. Ranged. High Critical.
description: The queen calls her swarm an heeds them to charge against you. No matter where you run, they will surround you. Hope you are not allergic to bees.

name: Discharge
effect: Area Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected.
description: The user lets out an enormous discharge over the arena. Lightning does not distinguish friend from foe.

name: Eruption
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. *Reduce 1 Dice from the Damage Pool for every missing HP the User has. Up to 5 dice may be removed this way.
description: A fierce burst of lava comes out from the Pokémon at full force, charring whatever comes in contact with it. The lava flow diminishes as the rage subsides.

name: Fire Fang
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 1st Degree Burn on the Target.
description: The Pokémon bites the foe with their mouth ablaze, tearing and searing their foe’s flesh in a single attack.

name: Guard Swap
effect: Single Target. Whole Scene Duration. Switch the User's Defense and Sp. Defense with the Target's.
description: The Pokémon enters their foe’s mind to steal its fortitude and implant on them the idea of their own weakness.

name: Gunk Shot
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
description: The target is covered heat to toe in sludge, filth and organic waste. It can’t even cry for help or all of it will go into its mouth.

name: Lick
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
description: The Pokémon licks the foe. The foe is deeply disturbed by this creepy display of “affection”.

name: Magnetic Flux
effect: Target User and Allies in range. Increase by 1 the Defense and Sp. Defense of Electric-Type or Steel-Type Targets.
description: The Pokémon alters the magnetic field around itself to repel damage. This also affects other Pokémon sensible to magnetic charges.

name: Parting Shot
effect: Single Target. Switcher Move for the User. Reduce by 1 the Foe's Strength and Special.
description: The user throws one last threat against the foe before taking their leave. The foe is left too frightened to try to stand up against the user and their gang.

name: Psychic Terrain
effect: Target Battlefield. Add 1 Extra Damage Dice to all Physical & Special Psychic-Type Moves. Pokemon without immunity to Ground can't use Moves with Reaction or Late Reaction. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The arena becomes radiated by psychic waves. Everyone feels their mind slog due to the buzz in their heads, making all tasks take longer than they should.

name: Sky Attack
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Charge Move. High Critical. Lethal. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target.
description: In a graceful but lethal strike, the Pokémon takes a deep dive towards the foe as if the sky was falling down right on top of it

name: Wicked Blow
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Fist Move. If the Accuracy Roll is successful, this Move becomes a Critical Hit.
description: The “Dark Style” is known as the most deadly and vicious of battle techniques. The user mastered this style and their punches are wicked strong.

name: Arm Thrust
effect: Single Target. Successive Actions.
description: A quick and relentless series of open-palmed thrusts against the foe.

name: Crush Grip
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. *If the foe has an HP higher than 4, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage pool for every exceeding point. Up to 9 Dice may be added this way.
description: The Pokémon grips the foe and starts crushing it. Small targets are difficult to grasp but larger bodies will not be released until they break.

name: Eternabeam
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Lethal. Must Recharge.
description: The Pokémon shoots an incredibly powerful beam towards the sky. The energy released might keep traveling through space thousands of years later.

name: Luster Purge
effect: Single Target. Unique. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce Sp. Defense by 1. *This effect can stack up to 3 times per Target.
description: The user engulfs itself in a blinding light and shoots a light beam at its foe, this light leaves the foe powerless to resist the assault.

name: Magic Room
effect: Target Battlefield. Held items lose their effects. No items can be used. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The entire battlefield becomes a room on which the laws of the material world are rendered useless.

name: Metronome
effect: Single Target. Copy Move. Roll a die to determine Physical or Special category, roll a die to determine this Move's Power. The appearance, Type and added effects of this Move becomes the same of a Physical or Special Move of the same Power at Storyteller's Discretion.
description: The Pokémon waves their hands following a specific rythm, the energy around follows the cadence and manifests as a Move at random.

name: Mist Ball
effect: Single Target. Unique. Projectile Move. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Reduce the Target's Special by 1. *This Effect can be stacked up to 3 times per target.
description: The user engulfs its foe with a cloud, this soothing mist keeps evil intents from surfacing ino the Target’s mind.

name: Moonlight
effect: Target Self. Basic Heal. If successful, spend 1 Will point to activate. Night Time and Sunny Weather increase it to Complete Heal. Rain, Sandstorm and Hail Weather reduceto Minor Heal of 1 HP.
description: The Pokémon uses the moon’s power to heal their injuries.

name: Safeguard
effect: Target User's side of the Field. Force Field. Those affected are immune to all Status Ailements/Conditions. Previously inflicted Status Ailments/Conditions remain. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: A force field covers half of the battlefield and filters out all impurities and ill intentions coming from the other side.

name: Acid Spray
effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
description: Do not point at face or eyes. Keep away from children.

name: Belch
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Sound Move. The user must eat a berry or something similar during the Round before using this Move, otherwise it will fail. This effect only works once per berry/food eaten.
description: The user shoots a blast of venomous pins that inject venom into the foe, this venom is specially potent against those already compromised.

name: Close Combat
effect: Single Target. Reduce by 1 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The Pokémon gets close enough to deal devastating damage, but the same can be said for the foe.

name: Counter
effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical Move. For damage, roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 dice. Ignore Defenses.
description: The Pokémon strikes back at their foe. Showing they can take a hit and punch even harder.

name: Encore
effect: Single Target. Reaction 3. The Target will repeat the exact same action sequence it had last Round. Target must have had an action sequence. Duration 1 Round. If used on the previous Round, this move fails. See more on p. 529.
description: The Pokémon makes a standing ovation at their target, prompting them to repeat everything they just did, exactly the way they did it.

name: Fishious Rend
effect: Single Target. Bite Move. *If this is the first Action of the Round for the User, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage pool of this Move.
description: This Pokémon uses their gills to snap at its target. Even if they don’t have teeth, their jaws have a crushing strength.

name: Infestation
effect: Single Target. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
description: The Pokémon summons a bothersome swarm to prevent the foe from escaping. The swarm will relentlessly attack the foe.

name: Metal Sound
effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 2.
description: A horrible screeching sound rumbles in the foe’s ears. Some people will try to convince you that this is good music.

name: Meteor Mash
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Fist Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to increase the User's Strength by 1.
description: A great meteor fell, leading to the extinction of all prehistoric Pokémon. The user re-enacts that meteor on a smaller scale, as it only needs to extinguish one.

name: Night Shade
effect: Single Target. Roll Ghost-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
description: The user casts a dark and frightening mirage surrounding the foe to give them a panic attack.

name: Pay Day
effect: Single Target. Ranged. At the end of the battle give Money to your Trainer Equal to their Rank: Starter/Rookie - 100 Standard - 250 Advanced - 500 Ace or more - 1000
description: This Pokémon brings good fortune to businesses and trainers alike. Make sure to use some of that hard earned money to buy them a treat.

name: Precipice Blades
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Lethal. Unique. Ignore the Target's Immunity to Ground-Type Damage. If a Target is "Out of Range" due to using any Move, this Move hits anyways.
description: Giant blades emerge from the earth impaling the unlucky souls nearby. Do you think you are safe in the air? Think again...

name: Rain Dance
effect: Target Battlefield. Activate Rain Weather. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The Pokémon performs a peculiar dance in the middle of the field, everyone thinks it silly until the first thunder rumbles.

name: Sleep Talk
effect: If the user is not asleep, this Move fails. Instead of making a roll to try to wake up, the user may choose to use Sleep Talk instead. Choose a Move on the user's Move set at random and Target Random foe with it. Sleep Talk can be repeated up to 5 times per Round.
description: Despite being asleep, the Pokémon keeps dreaming about the battle. They talk incoherences and even sleep walk.

name: Throat Chop
effect: Single Target. The target cannot use any "Sound Based" Move. Whole Scene Duration. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon.
description: A heinous attack to a Pokémon’s throat that will leave them unable to make a sound for hours.

name: Astonish
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Foe.
description: The user sneaks behind their target to jump scare them.

name: Avalanche
effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 4. *If the User received damage from the target during this Turn add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool. *If Snowy Weather is active add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
description: The user covers themselves with a heavy snow coat, if anything disturbs the snow, it will fall like a heavy avalanche.

name: Camouflage
effect: Target Self. For the rest of the scene the User changes type to one that fits the terrain/ environment it is in (ie User is in a rocky cave, becoming rock type).
description: The Pokémon blends with their surroundings to increase their chances of survival.

name: Core Enforcer
effect: Single Target. If the User has already received Damage from the Target this Round, Remove the Target's Ability for the rest of the scene. This effect does not end by switching out the affected Pokemon. Unique Abilities are not affected by this effect.
description: Zygarde shoots a beam that fractures the target to its core, rendering it unable to sustain even their own essence.

name: Energy Ball
effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Reduce the Target's Sp. Defense by 1.
description: Gathering nature’s energy from nearby plants, trees and roots, the Pokémon forms a ball to shoot at the enemy. Sadly, the surrounding plants will be dry afterwards.

name: Focus Blast
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Projectile Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Reduce the foe's Sp. Defense by 1.
description: A powerful energy blast that requires the user to chant each syllabe of the technique’s name and release it by yelling “Haaaaa!”

name: Freeze Dry
effect: Single Target. Water-Type Pokemon receive Super-Effective Damage from this Move. If a Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dive" this Move hits anyways.
description: All moisture is frozen and then subjected to high pressure, evaporating it immediately. Water-type Pokémon suffer this Move the most.

name: Grudge
effect: Single Target. The User Faints. Reduce the Target's Will to 0 points and reset any effect it got from spending them. Roll Target's Loyalty at the end of the round, increase difficulty by 1 each round. Failing this roll faints the Target.
description: The last words of this Pokémon imprint their grudge and anger over their foe. Depleting the foe of their will to carry on in this world.

name: Healing Wish
effect: Target Self. The user faints. One allied Target restores its full HP and it is cured from any Status Condition. If the chosen Target is not in-battle, it is called out and ready to fight with the same remaining actions as the user.
description: In a display of true selflessness, the user makes the ultimate sacrifice for the well-being of others.

name: Ice Ball
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Projectile Move. Successive Actions. *If all 5 actions land successfully, add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of the last hit of this Move. If the Pokemon used the Move "Defense Curl" in the same round, this Move's base Power becomes 2.
description: The Pokémon rolls into a snowball, getting bigger and bigger as they keep rolling

name: Lucky Chant
effect: Target User and Allies in Range. Unique. Targets can Re-roll one un-successful die from all their rolls. Critical Hits do not grant Bonus dice against the Targets. Whole Scene Duration. Out of battle, good things happen at Storyteller's Discretion.
description: The magical incantation of an old priestess, through dance and song, good fortune and divine protection will come to you. This Move also removes evil spirits and curses.

name: Mud Sport
effect: Target Battlefield. Physical & Special Electric-Type Moves have Power 0. Pokemon weak to Electric-Type Moves won't receive Super-Effective Damage from them. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: The user covers the whole field with mud. Electricity can’t flow properly, so Electric attacks will be severely impaired.

name: Round
effect: Single Target. Sound Move. *If the user and an ally are able to use Round. Both may choose to do it at the same time. If they do, add 3 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of both Pokemon.
description: The user attacks the foe with the power of music, if another one joins the performance, the musical harmony will rock their public!

name: Superpower
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Reduce by 1 the User's Strength and Defense.
description: The Pokémon packs all their power in a single crushing strike. All this effort leaves them quite tired afterwards.

name: Baton Pass
effect: Target Self. Switcher Move for the User. Any Attribute increase on the user is passed on the next Pokemon. The user can't increase its own Attributes again until the end of the scene or until the switched Pokemon faints.
description: The Pokémon rallies through the battle, setting up everything for the next companion as they know this is a team effort.

name: Blue Flare
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Unique. Roll 2 Chance Dice to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
description: Reshiram surrounds itself with giant blue flame that is unleashed with an earth shattering explosion. Receiving this attack directly might competely engulf you in fire.

name: Captivate
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Reduce by 2 the Special of those affected.
description: The Pokémon shows off their attractiveness and even flirts with the opponents, those who fall for their charms can’t keep focus on the battle.

name: Fiery Dance
effect: Single Target. Roll 5 Chance Dice to Increase User's Special by 1.
description: The Pokémon cloaks themselves in flames while dancing with graceful passion. The flames are scattered and the user feels reinvigorated.

name: Focus Energy
effect: Target Self. All of the user's Physical & Special Moves now have "High Critical". Whole Scene Duration.
description: The Pokémon concentrates all their focus on the battle to make their attacks much more precise.

name: Foresight
effect: Single Target. The Foe cannot Evade Moves performed by the User. User ignores Ghost-Type immunity to Normal and Fight-Type Moves and vice versa.
description: The Pokémon uses their honed senses and mental agility to predict the next movement of their foe.

name: Grapple
effect: Single Target. Blocks. The Target may resist this Maneuver by rolling Strength or Dexterity and scoring the same or more Successes than the User. The User can't Act while Grappling. The User can release the Grapple at any point to act.
description: Force the target into a wrestling lock; use a lasso rodeo-style; or simply cling onto one of their legs — the point is: you won’t let them escape!

name: Magnitude
effect: Area Move. Ranged. Before you roll damage, Roll 1 die to determine this Move's Power. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig" this Move hits anyways.
description: The user shakes the tectonic plates underneath the battlefield, trying to find a fault, when they do, this Move is devastating.

name: Return
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Extra Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for every point of Happiness on the User, up to 5 Dice may be added this way.
description: A loved Pokémon grows kind and happy, a Move fueled by gratitude.

name: Shadow Force
effect: Single Target. Charge move. Out of Range while Charging. Lethal. Unique. Ignore Defenses and any Shield Moves and Force Fields active on the Target. Damage dealt by this Move cannot be healed for 24 hrs.
description: The Pokémon dissapears into a dark dimension to strike its foe at the next opportunity. The blow will hurt the target not on their body but directly into their soul.

name: Smack Down
effect: Single Target. Ranged. Remove the Target's immunity to Ground-Type Moves. If the Target is Out of Range due to using "Fly", "Bounce" or "Sky Drop", this Move hits anyways.
description: They say it’s great to get two birds with one stone, this Pokémon will give one bird ALL the stones.

name: Sweet Scent
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Those affected cannot Evade Moves. Out of Battle, it will attract wild Pokemon.
description: The Pokémon releases a sweet aroma that lulls their enemies into a false sense of security

name: Telekinesis
effect: Single Target. Target becomes immune to Ground-Type Moves. Target can't Evade. Duration 2 Rounds.
description: The target levitates from the ground as the user’s telekinetic powers prevent its movement.

name: Water Pulse
effect: Single Target. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Confuse the Target.
description: The user sends out a pulsing ring of water that blasts the foe with ultrasonic waves. For a while, everything seems as if reflected in the water ripples.

name: Behemoth Blade
effect: Single Target. Cutter Move. Unique. *If the Foe is under the effects of Dynamax/Gigantamax, This Move becomes Lethal and add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
description: The Pokémon becomes a giant sword with a razor-sharp blade. If the foe is under the effects of the Dynamax phenomenon all its energy will be slashed to bits.

name: Bind
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficultty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
description: The Pokémon uses all their strength to restrain to the foe and keep them in place.

name: Bouncy Bubble
effect: Single Target. The User restores HP equal to half the damage dealt, rounded down. If the User of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: The user shoots bubbles at its target, the bubbles are filled up with fresh water and bounce back towards the user. Should you drink the water inside? Who cares? It’s fun!

name: Destiny Bond
effect: Target Self. If the user faints this Round due to damage frm a Physical or Special Move, the Pokemon who dealt the damage is dealt damage equal to their remaining Hp. This Move will fail if it was used the previous Round.
description: Through a mystical bond, everyone who brings disgrace to this Pokémon will suffer the exact same fate.

name: Flame Burst
effect: Single Target. After dealing damage, the User may roll 1 die of Fire-Type Damage against two other targets, ignoring defenses.
description: A compact fireball that bursts just as it hits the foe, scattering smaller flames to unsuspecting bystanders.

name: Freeze Shock
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Charge Move. Ranged. Lethal. Unique. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
description: The user appears to become a block of ice, then releases itself from the ice with a devastating discharge. The exploding ice shards and the lightning fly all over the battlefield.

name: Hone Claws
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Strength score and Accuracy Pools.
description: Sharp claws make for more precise and deadly attacks.

name: Obstruct
effect: Target Self. Reaction 4. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage the User would receive from a Damaging Move. *If the Foe used a Non-Ranged Physical Move against the user Reduce the foe's Defense by 2.
description: In a reckless action, the user charges against the foe to stop its momentum and block its incoming attack. Being so close allows the user to reach for weak spots.

name: Perish Song
effect: Area Move. Sound Move. Three Rounds after this Move is used, deal damage to those affected equal to their remaining HP. Removing from battle prevents this effect.
description: A song for mourning the departed. Although it sounds beautiful, it fills the heart with grief and despair, making the listeners feel as if they were laying on their death bed.

name: Psywave
effect: Single Target. Roll Psychic-Type Damage Dice according to the User's Rank: Starter 1 Die / Rookie 2 Dice / Standard 4 Dice/ Advacned 6 Dice / Expert 8 Dice / Ace and forward 10 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
description: A powerful mental wave assault’s the target’s brain directly. Everything, from forgotten memories to the secrets of the universe bombard its mind in just a few seconds.

name: Shell Smash
effect: Target Self. Increase by 2 the User's Strength, Special and Dexterity. Reduce by 2 the User's Defense and Sp. Defense.
description: The Pokémon breaks off their own shell. The foe mistakenly believed the shell was for the Pokémon to protect themselves when it was actually there to protect the foes from what’s next.

name: Sing
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Put the Target to sleep.
description: The Pokémon sings a lullaby; the sound is so comforting that it evokes memories of being tucked in bed and kissed good night.

name: Thunder Punch
effect: Single Target. Fist Move. Roll 1 Chance die to Paralyze the Target.
description: A charged punch to deliver a shocking blow.

name: Blizzard
effect: All Foes in Range. Low Accuracy 2. Lethal. Wind Move. Roll 1 Chance Die to Freeze those affected. *Sunny Weather increases to Low Accuracy 4. **Hail/Snowy Weather remove Low Accuracy and adds the effect "Never Miss".
description: The user summons a turbulent and gelid wind that feels like ice daggers. A pleasant day may make it difficult to call upon, but beware if the temperatures go below zero.

name: Calm Mind
effect: Target Self. Increase by 1 the User's Special and Sp. Defense.
description: The Pokémon takes a deep breath to increase the mental fortitude required to face any problem.

name: Frenzy Plant
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Must Recharge.
description: The user roots down and calls upon the force of nature. Thorny roots and plants grow in a frenzy around the foe. This display of power leaves the user quite exhausted.

name: Glaciate
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Lethal. Unique. Reduce by 1 the Dexterity of those Affected. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Freeze those Affected.
description: The air is so cold it hurts to move, to see, to breath. Escaping should be your top priority, for every second you don’t your life will be at peril.

name: Metal Burst
effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 5. Can only be used if Target's last Move on User was a Physical or Special Move. Roll dice equal to Target's last damage pool rolled against the User plus 2 Dice. Ignore Defenses.
description: Those who live by the sword will die by the sword, or, in this case, by an explosion.

name: Moongeist Beam
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. If anything on the foe's side would prevent this move from dealing damage (Pokemon Type, Abilities, Shield Moves, Weather or Force Fields) ignore it. This Move cannot be clashed.
description: A cold reflection of the moon shines upon the target, it doesn’t hurt physically but those who stare directly into the light simply collapse.

name: Overdrive
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Sound Move.
description: The Pokémon uses its own body as an amplifier for the energizing sounds it produces.

name: Sappy Seed
effect: Single Target. Low Accuarcy 1. Ranged. Spend 1 Will point to activate. At the end of the Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against one target. Ignore Defenses. The User deals 1 HP for every damage dealt this way. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: From a magical bean, the user grows a cute stalk that will attach itself to the nearest target. Once it ingrains, it will grow and grow and grow until it reaches the sky.

name: Sleep Powder
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Powder Move. Put the Target to Sleep.
description: The Pokémon spouts a cloud of somniferous pollen to know out their foe, the only problem is that the foe must inhale enough of the pollen for it to take effect.

name: Snore
effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. If the user is not asleep, this Move fails.
description: While the Pokémon is asleep they start snoring so loud it startles the foe.

name: Fusion Bolt
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. *If the Move "Fusion Flare" has already been used by anyone this Round, add 4 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move.
description: The Pokémon strikes with a devastating electric impact, said impact will grow larger and stronger if there’s a special kind of fire nearby.

name: Mind Blown
effect: Area Move. Recoil.
description: The Pokémon has had a terrible day and has a headache to match. Try not to disturb the peace because their head really feels like exploding.

name: Mind Reader
effect: Single Target. The User has 2 automatic and unremovable successes on the next Accuracy or Evasion Roll against the Target.
description: In a split of second, the Pokémon reads the foe’s mind so they know exactly what to do next.

name: Noble Roar
effect: Single Target. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Target's Strength and Special.
description: The mighty roar of a king. It commands respect and authority over anyone who listens.

name: Sludge Bomb
effect: Single Target. Projectile Move. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Poison the Target.
description: An explosive burst of organic waste directly into the target’s face. Nerves of steel are required not to throw your breakfast afterwards.

name: Spectral Thief
effect: Single Target. Unique. Before the User deals damage with this Move, steal all Attribute Increases the Target may have. Reduced Attributes on the Target remain.
description: Through the shadows, the user sneaks on its target to steal its life force and consume it, leaving the victim with a sense of grief and loss.

name: Stored Power
effect: Single Target. *Add 1 Die to the Damage Pool of this Move for each Attribute increase the User has, up to a maximum of 7 total Dice. (eg The User has 2 increased Points of Defense, add 2 Damage Dice.)
description: This move allows the user to release its power. If the user has any boosts, the damage is increased.

name: Whirlwind
effect: Single Target. Late Reaction 6. Wind Move. Switcher Move for the Foe. In the wild, the battle may end.
description: A strong whirlwind can send you flying away to who knows where. You better be wearing your red shoes.

name: Night Daze
effect: Single Target. Roll 4 Chance Dice to Reduce 1 Success from all Accuracy rolls of the foe. Outside of battle, obscuring effects last for a whole scene.
description: The foe is engulfed by a pitch-black darkness that obscure its vision and torments its mind.

name: Prismatic Laser
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Must Recharge. Unique.
description: Through a prism, the user shoots a concentrated laser beam that pierces everything that comes in contact with it. The effort leaves the user mentally exhausted.

name: Sand Tomb
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Ranged. Blocks. Ongoing Damage. Duration 4 Rounds. Increase the Target's difficulty to Evade at Storyteller's discretion.
description: The Pokémon creates a pit of shifting sand around the foe to bury it alive. The poor victim struggles for air as the sand keeps sinking it lower and lower.

name: Sparkling Aria
effect: Area Move. Sound Move. *If an effected Pokemon had any level of Burn Status Condition, heal it instead of dealing damage.
description: The Pokémon sings a beautiful melody, the song comes out as a sparkling fountain, bursting upon impact and quenching any fire in its path.

name: Toxic
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 2. Badly Poison the Target.
description: This burning acid dissolves skin to enter the bloodstream directly. The poor victim feels like they are melting from the inside out. The clock is ticking.

name: Rage
effect: Single Target. If a foe damages the User with a Physical or Special Move in the same round after using this Move. Increase the User's Strength by 1. This effect can stack up to 3 Times.
description: The user gets angry and throws a tantrum against the foe. The more the battle continues the angrier the user gets.

name: Sacred Fire
effect: Single Target. Lethal. Unique. Roll 5 Chance Dice to inflict 3rd Degree Burn on the Target.
description: A blazing pillar of rainbow-colored flames crashes upon the foe, it burns and cleanses all evil from within. Those with a pure heart should not fear for they shall be unharmed.

name: Snarl
effect: Target all foes in Range. Sound Move. Reduce by 1 the Special of those affected
description: The Pokémon viciously snarls showing its teeth to the foes. This menacing look will make everyone cower in fear.

name: Splishy Splash
effect: Target All Foes in Range. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Paralyze those affected. If the user of this Move is at its Final Stage of Evolution, this move fails.
description: The Pokémon rides a wave charged with electricity. It looks incredibly rad but it is also dangerous, as electrified water is not considered safe for surfing.

name: Stomping Tantrum
effect: Single Target. *Add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool of this Move if the User failed the Accuracy roll of the last Move it performed. If the Target is out of range due to using the Move "Dig", this Move hits anyways.
description: The Pokémon throws a tantrum and stomps all over the place, it becomes worse if something has previously frustrated them.

name: Supersonic
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 3. Sound Move. Confuse the Target.
description: The Pokémon shoots a series of ultrasonic waves that mess with the foe by making it feel dizzy and disoriented.

name: Tailwind
effect: Target User's side of the Field. Wind Move. Increase by 2 the Dexterity of everyone on the User's side of the field. Duration 4 Rounds.
description: Flying Pokémon know better than anyone how to use the wind in their favor. Let its draft carry you to victory.

name: Thunder Fang
effect: Single Target. Low Accuracy 1. Bite Move. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Flinch the Target. Roll 2 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Target.
description: The Pokémon bites the foe with charged fangs, basically injecting electricity right into the foe’s nervous system.

name: Yawn
effect: Single Target. *If the Target has not been removed from battle at the beginning of the next Round, put it to Sleep.
description: The user yawns, the foe yawns, the trainers yawn... everyone should take a nap.

name: Toxic Spikes
effect: Target Foe's side of the Field. Entry Hazard. Foes who enter the battlefield become Poisoned. Roll 1 Chance Die for them to become Badly Poisoned instead. Pokemon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
description: The Pokémon lays a trap of tiny venom-drenched spikes through the battlefield. The battle has not yet begun and the foes are already defeated.
